news.title: 中国存储器制造商长江存储希望在 2027 年底前取代三星和 SK 海力士
news.summary: YMTC has some big plans.

content.v: With the memory crisis in full swing, it's taking severe chunks out of the supplies of both NAND (used for SSD storage) and DRAM, which is used for RAM modules. Chinese memory maker YMTC has had a lucrative couple of years with the former, yet it's not done yet. YMTC reportedly wants to sit at the very top of the pile for NAND flash memory, and it wants to do it very soon.

According to the Financial Times , citing "two people with knowledge of the matter", YMTC told investors that it wants to be the leader in the market (ahead of Samsung and SK hynix) by the end of 2027. That's a pretty bold claim considering it would need to more than double its current market share.

According to Counterpoint Research , YMTC holds a 13% market share, while NAND memory leader Samsung holds 29%. In fairness, though, YMTC does appear to be building up its infrastructure to handle growth.

In April, it was reported that YMTC was aiming to more than double its wafer production . It would do so by building two additional foundries and finishing the build of a third foundry that was already under construction.

NAND memory is a very lucrative business right now. In the first quarter of 2026, NAND flash memory makers earned $46 billion in revenue, which is over 3.5 times what they made in the same quarter last year. NAND memory is only getting more expensive, and data centers are mopping it all up to train AIs and store all that data. But YMTC has even had a win in the consumer market, seemingly putting its SSDs into some Lenovo laptops . That's something it may have struggled to do previously, if it weren't for memory and storage supplies being so limited.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ud37mVu8Avvyg4UCgeMPGh.jpg

YMTC is reportedly also planning to make moves in the DRAM memory market , but it has CXMT, a different Chinese memory brand, to compete with there. CXMT has managed to pull in a 7% market share in the memory business, which isn't loads compared to the 39% held by Samsung, the 26% SK hynix has, and the 26% that Micron currently enjoys, but is quickly and steadily increasing.
It seems like China has two major memory manufacturers coming more decidedly into the global market, and given their surprisingly substantial market shares, they're coming in swinging.
As for the SSDs that you and I may put in our PCs, the market is looking mighty rough. We round up the best cheap SSD deals every week, and a 2 TB drive will cost you at least $200 right now.

More supply is obviously a good way of tackling the memory crisis, but one has to hope the supply goes up at a quicker rate than the already substantial demand, or we won't see any of the benefit of this heightened memory production. Even Samsung reckons we're in for a ' severe ' memory supply crisis next year, so things are looking bleak at least in the short-to-medium term.

news.title: Nvidia 的 DLSS 5 在网上泄露，改装者已经将其变成了 Slop 过滤器
news.titleEn: Nvidia's DLSS 5 Leaks Online, and Modders Have Already Turned It Into a Slop Filter

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/19/dlss-blog-1773918036233.jpg

Nvidia debuted DLSS 5 back in March 2026 , promising to bring neural rendering to games in order to make them look more realistic. While pretty much everyone hated it, it seems like Nvidia has continued to work on it behind the scenes: It's leaked in a build of the NBA 2K27 beta.

Twitter user @renan_maniero spotted the new DLSS file in the NBA 2K27 early access, called nvngx_dlssnr.dll. The 'nr' at the end there appears to stand for neural rendering. Just finding the file in the game's directory would be one thing, but it looks like some enterprising modders have been able to build it into some other existing games.
Eita, o acesso antecipado do jogo NBA 2K27 veio com uma DLL nova do DLSS. DLSS-NR (Neural Rendering) 👀 pic.twitter.com/X15fYO92RU

Some modders built a DLSS 5 mod and integrated it into Control , which was spotted by Gizmodo . In the initial post on X, you can see the modders manipulating some sliders to change the degree by which the neural renderer is changing the image. Things like auto skin mask, intensity and style are all customizable, which is something Nvidia said would be possible when it announced the technology earlier this year.

A YouTube video shows the mod in action, and from the moment neural rendering is enabled, the frame rate is cut nearly in half – from 95fps to 53. Keep in mind that right now the mod is limited to character models, and it really only has the effect of making Jessie look like she needs a nap.
在 Nvidia subreddit 上，一些改装者能够将这项技术应用到《最后生还者第二部分》中，虽然大多数启用了该技术的图像使角色看起来非常奇怪，但人们的反应似乎是分裂的。一位用户说 DLSS 5“看起来很糟糕，我不会撒谎”，这可能就是我现在坐的位置。还有人说，“细节更多，角色看起来更真实，不像皮克斯角色。”
显然，这项技术还处于非常早期的阶段，一旦游戏开发者能够自然地将其实际应用到游戏中并对其进行优化，可能不会对性能产生如此明显的影响。但很难想象开启 DLSS 5 会以任何方式提高你的帧速率，这使得它成为 Nvidia 的 AI 软件套件中首批让性能变得更差的部分之一。
不管怎样，现在支持该技术的 DLL 文件显然已经广泛存在，它真正进入市场只是时间问题。但如果 R​​TX 5090 的性能降低一半，我不知道我是否会建议任何人启用它，直到未来的显卡上市。
因为虽然该技术的视觉效果可能会一直争论到最后，但性能影响是 PC 游戏玩家决定是否值得使用该技术的地方。人们花了几年时间才开始真正开启光线追踪，因为它在早期肯定会让你的性能减半。一旦 Nvidia 真正发布这项技术，我就会以某种方式进行测试。
Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

news.title: GTA 6: All The Biggest Takeaways From The Big New Trailer That You Need To Know
news.summary: Rockstar finally lifted the veil on GTA 6 during a high-profile Netflix event on August 27. The nearly 30-minu

content.v: Rockstar finally lifted the veil on GTA 6 during a high-profile Netflix event on August 27. The nearly 30-minute video revealed a lot . We saw main characters Jason and Lucia in action in snippets of multiple different missions, while there were cutscenes and character interactions on display as well.

The broadcast also featured a new look at some of the updated gameplay systems, like how NPCs will notice if you're carrying a weapon in public , how stealing cars works , and that the game has a Red Dead Redemption 2-style honor system .

There were numerous other details big and small to be gleaned from the reveal, along with interviews from developers at Rockstar North. Check out GameSpot's video below in which Jake Dekker runs through 29 different things we noticed in GTA 6 from the big new trailer, and I'm guessing we found some stuff you didn't notice right away. Check out the video below to see it all.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is likely going to be a PC edition of the game, but no one should expect it at launch .

While Rockstar Games has shown off GTA 6's single-player, the developer has yet to utter a word about anything regarding an online multiplayer mode . GTA 5's GTA Online has been, and continues to be, a huge success for Rockstar, so it only stands to reason that Rockstar would lean into multiplayer for GTA 6 as well.

news.title: 6 更多魔法：我们想要的超越宇宙中的聚会交叉
news.summary: With MTG’s Universes Beyond lineup expanding, here are 7 more ideal fantasy and sci-fi crossovers we want to s

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/7-more-mtg-crossover-ideas-ign-1787588324845.png

Not too long ago, we put together a wishlist of seven Magic: The Gathering crossovers we'd love to see in Universes Beyond ( whether that's in 2027 or in the next few years). Well, I've been thinking about it again, and, frankly, there are still far too many great possibilities out there to stop at seven.

With Magic's Universes Beyond lineup continuing to expand, I've decided to throw six more potential crossovers into the ring. Some are obvious, some are perhaps a little more out there, but all of them feel like they'd fit surprisingly well into Magic's increasingly expansive multiverse.
As we covered in that original wishlist, we know Magic has three more Universes Beyond sets lined up for 2027, arriving in April, August, and November.
Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks has also suggested that next year's crossovers will be "a bit more fantasy-adjacent", following feedback from fans on some of the more recent collaborations.

That still leaves a huge amount of room for speculation, and more than enough fantasy worlds we'd love to see collide with Magic. So, here's our sequel: six more Universes Beyond crossovers we'd love to see.
The Elder Scrolls

Starting things off, The Elder Scrolls. While we are still painstakingly awaiting The Elder Scrolls VI , an eventual crossover with Magic: The Gathering wouldn't be beyond the realms of imagination, especially if we're talking epic fantasy.
Bethesda has already partnered with Magic as part of the Universes Beyond: Fallout set, so extending that partnership to Bethesda's other gaming titan... It just works.

Honestly, I probably should have included this in the original article. I can absolutely see this happening in the near future. Whether that's in 2027, or whenever The Elder Scrolls VI eventually releases in the (fingers crossed) next few years.
Supernatural

Okay, admittedly, this is one of my more "out there" picks for a Magic: The Gathering crossover. It's absolutely fantasy-adjacent, but its 21st-century setting may put off more than a few diehard Magic fans. Still, I'm going to die on this hill, because I genuinely think Supernatural could make for a fantastic Universes Beyond set.

The show's mythology almost already feels tailor-made. Magic has Angels and Demons as established creature types, while the show's spells, rituals, curses and supernatural artefacts could slot neatly into the game's existing card types. Then you've got 15 seasons of monsters, supernatural creatures and a ridiclously extensive cast of characters to draw from. It pretty much sorts itself at this rate.

Plus, Universes Beyond has already shown that Magic can accommodate worlds that look and feel very different from its traditional fantasy settings. If anything, the show's grimy Americana, roadside diners, abandoned churches, forests and endless motel rooms could give the set a visual identity unlike anything else in Magic.

Beyond all that, Supernatural was an absolutely massive part of the TV landscape for years, and the nostalgia for it is very real. A set like this would be tapping into a fanbase that grew up with Sam and Dean, making it a potentially huge nostalgia play for both Supernatural fans and new Magic players.
The Chronicles Of Narnia

If Wizards of the Coast really is looking to lean further into fantasy with its next Universes Beyond sets, then The Chronicles of Narnia feels like an obvious contender. It's difficult to think of many properties that fit Magic's traditional fantasy aesthetic quite as naturally, with talking animals, witches, kings, mythical creatures and epic battles all baked into the world of Narnia.

There's also a huge amount of material to work with across the seven books, from Aslan, the Pevensie siblings and the White Witch to Mr. Tumnus, Caspian, Reepicheep and the countless creatures of Narnia. And while the books are decades old , the movies from the 2000s mean there's a hefty dose of nostalgia here too. Plus, there's that Greta Gerwig adaptation upcoming in 2027 as well.

Narnia feels like exactly the kind of crossover that could appeal to both longtime Magic players and a whole new audience, while being one of the easiest Universes Beyond properties to slot into Magic's fantasy world.
Buffy the Vampire Slayer

If we're talking about properties that could tap into a serious well of nostalgia, Buffy the Vampire Slayer feels like another strong contender. Like Supernatural, it's a modern setting that might seem a little strange alongside Magic's traditional fantasy worlds, but the actual subject matter fits surprisingly well... again!

Vampires, demons, witches, werewolves, ghosts and a whole host of other supernatural nasties would give Wizards plenty to work with. Albeit, again, similarly to Supernatural, so I wouldn't expect to see both in Universes Beyond.
Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere Universe

Brandon Sanderson’s Cosmere Universe feel tailor-made for Universes Beyond. Sanderson has previously said that WotC reached out for a potential partnership, but progress stalled a couple of years ago due to other projects taking priority.
Whether split into distinct Mistborn and Stormlight Archive Commander decks within a complete set, or launched as a full tentpole release for each series, this feels like a match made in heaven.
Because Sanderson is an outspoken MTG player , who has previously written official lore for Wizards of the Coast , the connection goes far deeper than basic brand synergy as well.
So, this seems like another sure bet to me, if both parties can get things up and running again.
The Wheel of Time

If Wizards really does want to lean into more fantasy-adjacent Universes Beyond sets, Robert Jordan's sprawling fantasy world seems almost tailor-made for Magic. Somehow I'm also mentioning Brandon Sanderson again as well, who famously stepped in to bring Jordan's masterwork across the finish line .

The Wheel of Time gives you an enormous amount of material to work with, so this seems like an easy fit, whether that's in 2027, or beyond that. And with the recent Amazon series introducing the world to a new generation of fans, the timing feels pretty good too. If only they hadn't cancelled it, it was getting really good!
Those are our new predictions/ additions to the wistlist, but what are you expecting from Universes Beyond in the coming years? Let us know in the comments!

news.title: Rockstar 必须“小心”GTA 6 选择讽刺的内容，因为“非常具体的政治问题或模因很快就会过时”
news.summary: So no Skibidi Toilet? Got it.

content.v: The veil between satire and reality has seemed so thin for such a long time now that I find myself double checking every other news post I see just to make sure it's not something from The Onion—sadly it never is. But I guess it could be worse, I could be the one who has to write the satire, I could be the one who has to write scripts for GTA 6 .

It's certainly a tall order, especially right now, but if someone's able to do it I'm confident in Rockstar, who should be able to pull off some meta-commentary about the make-believe state of Leonida, based on Florida, and the US at large.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/G4f2zTefXPF8tS4yaTLqWf.jpg

"That’s a question a lot of people ask: how do you deal with satire in today’s world?" Rockstar North's co-studio head, Ron Nelson, tells IGN . "I think there’s always stuff to satirize. As long as humans are humans, other humans will figure out ways to satirize what we do."

Sure, they'll always be people who will satirize the world around them, but the key here is doing it well enough that it doesn't make players' eyes permanently roll into the back of their heads, while also holding up against the test of time. Rockstar surely wants people to play and enjoy GTA 6 beyond 2026.

"We have to be careful that what we’re choosing to satirize is not going to feel dated in a weird way," Nelson explains. "I think those broader things are OK to satirize, but very specific political issues or memes will date fast. Even the way our characters speak, we think about it a lot so that they're not using extremely contemporary slang. Even though our characters are a certain age, they need to feel somewhat timeless."
That probably means we won't be seeing any brainrot or references to the orange man in GTA 6, and you know what? Thank god—sometimes art doesn't need to fully imitate life.

news.title: 百大UP锐评《昭和米国》："B级片"气质 并非面面俱到
news.summary: 日前，国内开发商铃空游戏打造的《昭和米国物语》在科隆游戏展公开了全新实机演示，独特的复古美学与荒诞风格再次引发玩家讨论。

content.v: 日前，国内开发商铃空游戏打造的《昭和米国物语》在科隆游戏展公开了全新实机演示，独特的复古美学与荒诞风格再次引发玩家讨论。
视频回顾：
哔哩哔哩游戏区UP主、2018年百大UP主@芒果冰OL此前参加了《昭和米国物语》的国内试玩活动，并分享了自己的体验感受。他认为，这款游戏最大的特点就是浓厚的“B级片”气质，玩家是否能够接受这种风格，将直接影响实际游玩体验。
他表示：“《昭米》绝对是个B级片式的游戏，能对上胃口的人肯定不会觉得乏味，但如果追求面面俱到，或者拿一些大作来要求它的细节质量，那多半会失望。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261633256356.png
从他的评价来看，《昭和米国物语》并不是一款试图在所有方面都达到3A大作水准的作品，其核心魅力更在于独特的风格、荒诞的设定以及充满恶搞元素的表达方式。对于喜欢这种“B级片”调性的玩家来说，游戏的缺点或许并不会成为太大的问题；但如果以主流3A作品的标准去衡量画面、战斗等细节，则可能产生较大的落差。
此前，外媒IGN东南亚在试玩后也给出了相近的评价。IGN认为，《昭和米国物语》成功打造出了一个令人难忘且风格极其独特的B级电影世界，但这种刻意保留的“粗粝感”和高度小众的风格，也意味着游戏目前的整体打磨程度仍落后于其他现代3A动作游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261634141830.jpg
此外，《昭和米国物语》中密集的文化恶搞与各种复古元素也给外媒留下了深刻印象。不过，IGN同样提出了一个值得关注的问题：当这种高度密集的恶搞和独特风格被延续到数十小时的完整流程后，能否始终保持新鲜感，而不是逐渐让玩家产生审美疲劳。

news.summary: 近日，中国台湾媒体拍到了林志颖乘坐焕新版特斯拉Model Y出行的一幕，在活动结束后，他坐上了由助理驾驶的特斯拉Model Y回家。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282312168317.jpg
近日，中国台湾媒体拍到了林志颖乘坐焕新版特斯拉Model Y出行的一幕，在活动结束后，他坐上了由助理驾驶的特斯拉Model Y回家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282312177853.jpg
事件回溯到2022年7月22日，林志颖驾驶白色特斯拉Model X，带着儿子行驶在桃园中正北路，车辆撞上道路隔离带后迅速起火燃烧，现场情况万分凶险，热心路人及时将被困车内的父子二人救出。
两人被救出来仅仅数秒，火势就吞噬了整个驾驶舱，整车车头几乎烧成骨架，如果救援稍有延迟，后果不堪设想。
这场车祸让林志颖身受重伤，颜面骨折、肱骨粉碎性骨折，还伴随脑部损伤，经历多次手术与漫长康复才逐步恢复；坐在副驾的儿子仅脸部擦伤，幸无大碍。事后林志颖回忆，自己苏醒之后第一件事，就是确认头部和手脚还在，足以见得当时生死一线的处境。

news.summary: 索尼正式发布其27英寸PlayStation游戏显示器。这款显示器最早于2025年11月的State of Play活动上公布，如今终于正式上市，售价349美…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282304341250.png
索尼正式发布其27英寸PlayStation游戏显示器。这款显示器最早于2025年11月的State of Play活动上公布，如今终于正式上市，售价349美元（约合人民币2347元）。
新品采用27英寸Fast IPS面板，分辨率为2560×1440（QHD）。在PS5和PS5 Pro上最高支持120Hz刷新率，在兼容的PC和Mac上则最高可达240Hz。同时支持可变刷新率（VRR）、HDMI VRR以及AMD FreeSync Premium。
其最大特色之一，是显示器底座内置了可折叠的手柄充电挂钩，可以用来放置并为DualSense或DualSense Edge无线手柄充电。挂钩在不使用时可以折叠隐藏，不会额外占用桌面空间。
这款显示器主要面向习惯在桌面环境使用游戏主机、而不是连接客厅电视的玩家。外观方面采用白色机身搭配黑色底座，并配有简约的PlayStation标志，整体设计风格与PS5保持一致。

news.summary: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快” 本周出场人物：柏亚舟 白广大 引擎

content.v: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”
本周出场人物：柏亚舟 白广大 引擎
柏亚舟：巴别塔
科隆的展前发布会上，主持人Geoff不免感慨，我们正处在一个艰难的阶段，游戏行业面临裁员浪潮，游戏玩家要应对硬件普遍涨价，但依然有这么多的开发者，他们依然在持续创造茫茫多优秀作品，然后来到这里相聚。
https://image.gcores.com/e4fa97e9385ff6d6629967cf5f9a9dd0-1440-1080.jpg
其实Geoff说得还不够大，我们甚至可以说，世间纷纷扰扰，只有游戏在让我们团结。这几天的Koelnmesse，几乎就是一座具象的巴别塔，两年前我就有过这样的感受，今年的感受更加明显。
也许原因之一就是中国游戏又变多了，根据不完全统计，这次来了72家中国游戏公司，这还没有算上投资关系，我老是说自己不喜欢国产游戏目前面对的「超级红利」和「超级黑利」现象，总说所有游戏都要统一标准、要好玩，但真正看到同胞们的「超级展台」有来自世界各地的玩家大排长龙，内心没有多余的情感也是不可能的。
除了多，这次来的国产游戏类型也全。在展期发布会，前面几个游戏播片之后，我和翟睿甚至发出了「前面有几个非国产」的感慨，我原本有点担心偏见的存在，但打开科隆官方的油管频道，下面的评论提及的都是游戏本身，而非国籍，偶尔能看见一些质疑，但点赞数还不如「Bring Valko Back」的情愿多。
也感谢AI，实时交流的提速，在这次展会上感受非常明显。在to b展台这边，人们的交流比以往还要热烈，还要人满为患，处处可见小圆桌，以及小圆桌周围认真的讨论；to c展台这边，陌生人因为cos服装、因为熟悉道具打招呼，成了真正意义上的「游戏拉近你我」。
我就遇到了一个背着两米长金箍棒的老哥，一开始还不是很确定是金箍棒，直到我发现倒着的篆体「棒」和「箍」两个字，我说嘿你喜欢《黑神话：悟空》吗，他说当然！于是就有了这张合影。
https://image.gcores.com/70f5a75915781b0bb185ba768dcb2239-1080-1440.jpg
一代一代的人都想修巴别塔，但在绝大多数年代，隔阂、误解乃至冲突才是主流。游戏本无意背负这些，但游戏又创造了一种可能。
白广大：G-Buddy 和 GTA6
首先推荐一位机组的新朋友。
之前我vibe过一个机组日历的小功能，但后来发现对服务器严重不友好，就下架了。现在我们机组用户自己做的这个小机器人有了“那年今日”的全部功能，而且进入页面还可以把它当做一个普通的AI来使用，有一些我们机核自己的熟梗在里面。在此感谢这位创造了G-Buddy的机核用户！
另外说一下今天早上醒来就看见了GTA6 从网线里伸出来的铁拳，看了最新的26分钟演示片，实在是有点按捺不住了，人类游戏工业顶级的“提升密度”的奇观，或许空前绝后。
但是这里又涉及到另一个事情，就是PS5 Pro的涨价曲线。
https://image.gcores.com/e5f0acbd0f24843b185e75a06e44bfe3-1280-960.png

索尼首席执行官户冢弘树对PlayStation主机成本上涨并不特别担忧。在接受《华尔街日报》最新采访时，他表示内存短缺来得正是时候。在PS5经历数次涨价后，该公司计划将重心放在PS Plus订阅用户身上，而非硬件营销。4月份的最新一轮PS5涨价将光盘版的建议零售价从600美元上调至650美元。与此同时，数字版的售价从500美元涨至600美元，而PS5 Pro的售价也从750美元涨至900美元。 该制造商将人工智能数据中心的扩张与存储和内存成本上涨联系在一起。
当前在小黄鱼上的基础价格为：
https://image.gcores.com/13aa0b9eaaebf2a7637f7408909ac58d-1080-2147.jpg
可谓强而有力，简称强力。而在Rockstar 方面来看，《GTA 6》首发不登陆PC平台的原因是：“如果先做PC版本，主机版本就很容易烂尾”。
John Ricchio在播客KIWI TALKZ中表示：Rockstar并非"不在乎PC玩家"，而是基于游戏开发流程的技术考量，Rockstar早期的游戏开发多采用PC优先策略，团队会在性能最强大的PC硬件上进行开发，最后再将成品缩减并移植至规格较低的家用主机。然而这种做法往往导致开发尾声阶段，团队必须耗费大量精力在性能有限的主机上进行移植优化，甚至因此造成糟糕的主机移植品质。
https://image.gcores.com/05be24a892f0730eb85416b2a4e7f038-1280-720.png
好好好。
然而，从GTA3开始，Rockstar的策略就从来都是： 需求曲线永远卡在"略高于主流、远低于顶级"的甜点区； 主机先行 7—19 个月、PC 版做"第二波"硬件消费潮； 媒体装机文、厂商捆绑促销、网吧换代连续勾引； 每代 GTA 都是此后 3—5 年的跑分参照器。
GTA5可以横跨PS3到PS5的世代，不是没道理的。今年2月的报导：Take-Two Interactive 在最新一季的财报中披露，《三男一狗》的累计销量已达到2.25亿份，相比上一份财报中公布的2.2 亿份再次增长，又卖了500万份。考虑到地球上的80 亿人里有手机的大约 56 亿，没有手机（尤其是没有智能手机）的还有 20 多亿人。
每当硬件代际切换需要一个"让亿万人心甘情愿掏钱的理由"，GTA 就是那个理由。因此Rockstar宣布要让新作卖出50亿美元应该不是问题。
但是还有另外一个因素：过去一年是人类半导体科技发展彻底抛弃游戏的一年。AI 数据中心需求把 DRAM/NAND 产能瞬间掏干，民用内存一年涨 3–5 倍、固态一年涨 2–3 倍，直接后果是游戏 PC 装机成本近乎翻倍、玩家推迟升级甚至放弃 DIY。这可能是家用游戏 PC 市场二十年来第一次集体"用不起内存和硬盘"。
祝福Rockstar，请大家多多使用G-Buddy。
引擎：18 点 55 分的机核网
引擎瘫在白色塑料椅子上，腰部空着，脸冲着窗户，撇了眼手机，现在是18点55分。
18点55分，从20层高楼往下看，立交桥上的路灯会同时点亮。一整排的编辑工位空无一人。
https://image.gcores.com/278ac921c5c86ee207f3b5335c05a313-3024-4032.jpeg
Jerry挂着证件，在场馆里四处奔走，身边有人在说德语，他可能不知道，科隆在下雨。
四十二在家，双手飞快地敲击着键盘，顾不上因病而麻木的右手，因为互联网捎来了甲方的需求。
豆哥在讲日语，不禁思考地按下了电梯上的按钮，他比门口那个背着黑色双肩包，焦急等电梯的小哥还要熟悉大楼的布局。因为这里是史克威尔在东京新宿的办公大楼。
白老师在远处，被两台屏幕包围，一台竖着。光头在反射屏幕的光。
萝卜的工位上传来劣质键盘噼啪作响的敲击，一把三十五包邮的键盘一字一字敲出的是最新一期的故事节目。
“走，录。”萝卜冲我招呼。
空调会在18点59分准时关闭。我的静息心率是99。
男厕所左数第三个池子，会在冲水时爆发出如丰水期的壶口瀑布一般的声响。
而现在是22点36分，我要在十分钟内，上交一篇记事本！！！

news.summary: 《GTA6》中出现了警察对着已经举手投降的黑人射击的镜头，引发了部分争议，你怎么看？

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA6》中出现了警察对着已经举手投降的黑人射击的镜头，引发了部分争议， 你怎么看？
在《GTA6》最新公布的宣传画面中，出现了一幕警察向已经举双手投降的黑人嫌疑人直接开枪射击的镜头。
知名游戏主播Asmongold在直播观看了该画面后忍不住发笑，这一举动迅速在社区中引发了一定的舆论风波和探讨。
面对部分群体对主播大笑行为的质疑，大量的玩家与网友站出来为其澄清，并指出这仅仅是对《GTA》系列游戏里警察 AI 一贯“荒诞离谱”设定的嘲讽：
“那是因为警察喊完‘别动’之后，就算人家举着双臂一动不动，警察也照样直接开枪射击。显然是因为这个原因。”

content.v: 《GTA6》最新27分钟实机演示公开后，海外玩家社区一篇热门帖子引发大量共鸣。一名玩家表示，自己此前对女主角露西亚并不感冒，相比之下更期待男主角杰森，但看完最新实机后却彻底改变了看法。

news.title: GTA6实机2K30帧！数毛社赞史上最惊艳 Pro版更强？
news.summary: 数毛社确认《GTA6》的实机是以2K 30FPS运行的，对此你怎么看？

content.v: 由你来说： 数毛社确认《GTA6》的实机是以2K 30FPS运行的，对此你怎么看？
知名技术分析机构Digital Foundry今日发布了针对《GTA6》扩展前瞻实机画面的初步分析报告。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282235178615.jpg
据DF确认，本作在基础版PS5上以原生1440p分辨率、稳定30帧运行，未使用任何升频技术（如FSR或PSSR），且全程保持稳定帧率。
DF将此次展示称为“有史以来在视觉上最令人印象深刻的游戏演示”。
针对PS5 Pro的预期表现，DF分析认为该机型将有望实现更高分辨率与更优光线追踪效果，但具体帧率目标尚未明确。
这一技术信息迅速在玩家社群中引发激烈讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282235373219.jpg
部分玩家对Rockstar的优化能力表示赞叹：“Rockstar是第一个真正用满这一代主机全部性能的开发商，他们又一次为行业设下了难以企及的标准。”
也有玩家对Pro版的性能模式抱有期待：“希望Pro版能在首发时提供原生4K/30帧，即使有60帧模式，我也会选30帧享受顶级画质——这游戏看起来太完美了。”
然而，关于帧率的争议同样尖锐。有玩家直接表态：“如果Pro版不能跑60帧，我就取消预购。我没在那30分钟里看到任何必须首日游玩的内容。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282235011701.png
更多玩家则在追问基础版是否会提供性能模式。
截至发稿，Rockstar尚未就帧率与分辨率细节作出进一步官方说明。

news.title: Sabre Boss 对实体游戏的消亡和游戏机价格上涨的反应
news.summary: 2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for phy

content.v: 2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028 and the trend of consoles getting increasingly expensive. Tim Willits, the chief creative officer at Saber Interactive, caught up with GameSpot at Gamescom this week to discuss these topics and offer up a bizarre-sounding possibility for an "AI box" for games.

He said he was "surprised how upset people were" about Sony ending support for physical game discs. Willits said he hasn't bought a physical game "in a long time" because he enjoys the convenience of digital games. Willits is not alone, as the share of digital game sales is growing at numerous companies.

At the same time, Sony continues to sell millions of physical game discs annually . Willits said Saber still makes "a lot of money" from physical games, especially in Europe, but the trends are different in North America, he observed.

Willits went on to say he had an interaction with someone recently who asked him to sign a copy of Doom 3, a game he worked on when he was with id Software. "So for me personally, I'll miss that in the future," he said.
An AI game box?
Part of what many people enjoy about physical games is collecting the boxes they come in and presenting them on their shelves.
Willits said he thinks someone in the future might create some kind of "AI box" into which players can "upload all your games."
"So maybe someone will do that," he said.
Rising console prices

Another major storyline in gaming in 2026 has been how video game consoles today are more expensive than ever . There are numerous reasons for this, including US President Donald Trump's tariffs, the AI-fueled impact on component and memory prices, and more.

Sony and Microsoft raised prices on PlayStation and Xbox consoles so much that the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles are now $150+ more expensive than they were when they launched in 2020. Nintendo, meanwhile, is hiking the price of the Switch 2 in September.

For his part, Willits said it's "shocking how expensive" it has become to buy a new console today, adding that it will "be interesting to see" how Sony and Microsoft manage this as they look to release new consoles.

A new report from Ampere Analysis said that if next-gen consoles do, in fact, come in at $1,000 or more, that could have a dramatic, negative effect on the market. To be sure, Sony and Microsoft have yet to detail their plans for new consoles, so there is no word yet on how much they might cost or when they could be release.
In other news, Willits told GameSpot more about the company’s plans to use AI in game development and how the company claims it will never fire anyone and replace them with AI .

news.title: 《异克斯小队》试玩会：我又要给哪个黑心老板卖命了？
news.summary: 作者：萝卜 在ChinaJoy期间，我有幸参加了一场《异克斯小队》的线下试玩，也就是最近在科隆游戏展上放出新片的三人联机PVE动作射击游戏。 哪怕把游戏本身放在一边，作为一次线下闭门试玩来说，也是体验不错的。出于其三人联

content.v: 在ChinaJoy期间，我有幸参加了一场《异克斯小队》的线下试玩，也就是最近在科隆游戏展上放出新片的三人联机PVE动作射击游戏。
哪怕把游戏本身放在一边，作为一次线下闭门试玩来说，也是体验不错的。出于其三人联机PVE的本质，我与另外两位来自其他媒体的老师组成了一队，由我担任队长，一起简单体验了这款游戏，结下了战友情。是的，我们这个行业偶尔也是能出现一些同行情谊的。
《异克斯小队》由加拿大知名团队 Behaviour Interactive研发，国内由腾讯游戏发行，STC游戏产品部合作出品。海外由 Level Infinite 发行，TEAM SHOOTER & CREATIVE合作出品。游戏将于2027 年登陆 PC / PS5 / Xbox Series X|S，并在即日起开放愿望单。
该作的制作人以及核心团队有着丰富的3A游戏制作经验，参加过《孤岛惊魂2》，《彩虹六号：异种》《全境封锁》《刺客信条》等作品的开发。
悲催的打工人，在异形遍布的行星表面上作战
媒体老师们被分为三人一组，组队开始游戏。我与一名有一定游戏经验的同行老师，以及一名几乎没有动作射击游戏经验的媒体老师组成了小队，先从低难度开始体验。
https://image.gcores.com/28858b78bcc5e1fae2dbccde33d494bd-828-466.png
在这个三人成行的游戏模式里，玩家在出发之前要先由队长选择任务目标，这将决定前往的星球，难度，以及任务目标和敌人种类。然后大家再选择这次出击要配备的装备，包括主武器，特殊武器，道具，以及最重要的：武器上的模组。
我们一开始被禁止使用任何模组，因为模组十分强力，大家先从未装模组的朴素武器开始体验，这时我很轻易联想到了《星际战甲》的模组系统。但是后来体验到本作的模组系统后，意识到也不尽一样。
三人出发进入地图后，随时与“公司总部”保持通讯，队长打开地图之后标记位置，全队一起向目标进发。沿途有充满敌意的野生生物前来阻挠，也被我们的步枪轻松解决。至于敌人本身，很难用某种地球生物来把他们简单类比，只能形容为各种奇怪的外星动物，攻击方式也多种多样。有的喜欢突脸，有的喜欢在远处默默对玩家蓄个大的。
玩家之间也存在足额的友军伤害，一不注意就会打死自己人。打死自己人之后，可以使用一个复活枪把一个新的队友“射到”目标位置，同时在目标位置还会形成爆炸，杀伤范围内的其他队友或敌人，并把刚复活的队友投入险境。
玩家扮演的角色名为“Exterminauts”，这个词是由“灭害”和“宇航员”融合而成，基本也代表了玩家的核心任务：消灭生物，完成公司指定的工作。
来到任务地点后，通常就是一些非常简单的疏通，激活，防守类的工作，完成一项工作就可以前往下一个地点，也有许多支线任务供玩家选择。时不时地图上会突然弹出一个存在时间任务的临时任务，想要拿到奖励的话就要立刻前往。这种任务的本质是你的老板突然决定让你“加个班”。
https://image.gcores.com/814aee487caa40739f39abd8a1c3d65f-828-466.png
https://image.gcores.com/39463b0fc6d1d36601ffe6a94f0132cf-828-466.png
在这个简单难度里，我们体验到了与《绝地潜兵2》类似的玩法流程，而更多的差异性体验随着难度的提高逐渐浮出水面。
在中等难度下，大家开始研究给武器装什么模组。游戏提供了丰富的构筑方案，在稍微研究之后我给自己构筑了一套以暴击触发特效为核心思路的模组，而我的队友则构筑了一套以治疗和生存为主的玩法。再次进入游戏后，随着我一梭子子弹打到大型怪物身上，许多酸液，闪电，火焰开始迸发，特效满天飞，原本很肉的敌人在我的build面前被瞬间融化，感受到了一种数值上的爽快。
https://image.gcores.com/334748502db813b9f3bcc1b9f7b2aecd-828-466.png
而我那个生存治疗构筑的队友基本失去了杀伤能力，但是凭借极强的治疗效率跟在我身边给我补血，我们基本上组成了一种输出与治疗的强强配合。这种相对“极化”的构筑体验让我意识到这也许是这个游戏的核心乐趣，这个乐趣主要来自于武器模组的选择和配合，而制作团队也说，这些模组不会难以获得，或者让大家肝很久才能得到。
在撤离阶段，地图上的敌人会来围攻撤离点，这个时候三位队员可以比赛谁杀的更多，屏幕上会出现一个计分板。我自己杀够了全队总分数的95%，可见正确的模组构筑的重要性。
除此之外，玩家在游戏内可以获得弹药和物资的补给，但这些补给也是要花公司预算的，而这个预算会从玩家这次任务的工资里扣除，那么如何用最少的资源完成任务来赚取更多的利润也成了玩家要考虑的问题。
https://image.gcores.com/a3917273287ac54805e7a4fad047ba97-828-466.png
勇敢的打工人，在大企业的压迫下维持生活
在《异克斯小队》里，玩家也服从一家超大法西斯组织（为啥要说“也”）。
《异克斯小队》的故事发生在遥远的天穹星（Tian）。这颗星球上发现了一种全新的奇迹能源“多态等离子体”，引爆了一场席卷星际巨头的“淘金热”，也带动了开采、精炼与运输技术的飞速发展。然而这种物质对于许多异形生物来说如同蜜糖一般诱人，于是企业与生物之间的战争愈演愈烈，玩家们置身其中，又要完成开采任务，又要消灭异形生物。
https://image.gcores.com/31213df77528965e75261e3bd66be692-828-466.png
https://image.gcores.com/121a500e1b979df5429176dbf62dc7f7-828-466.png

在美术方面，玩家拥有自定义宇航服的丰富选项，但大部分设计思路都围绕着“蓝领”这个主题展开，荧光黄色的醒目配色在欧美人看来就是工人制服特有的颜色，所以许多宇航服也都是这种包含工地元素的服装。从硬质安全帽、护目面罩、隔音耳罩、呼吸防护面具，到绑带、护垫、反光条、耐磨工作手套、随手可取的工具袋、连体工装和安全靴，装备清一色是一线劳保防护用品，细节拉满。原因也很实在：在遍地异种、险象环生的异星上，把自己保护好，永远是第一要务。
https://image.gcores.com/8c9f4e7a30769bd70e1cab621b4adfee-828-466.png
而武器方面，除了工人们防身使用的步枪，冲锋枪，霰弹枪等，真正的大杀器反而是一个个“工具”。比如原本用来冷冻和稳定环境的冷冻器，在玩家的小小“超载”之后，可以发射出相当惊人的巨型冷冻气体，一瞬间把目光所及范围内的一切变成冰雪世界，包括喜欢乱动的可怕敌人，以及你无辜的队友。相信我，发射超载冰冻炮的那一刹那，视觉效果真的很炸裂。
https://image.gcores.com/8ae76b740314bfeba1d12acfd83f25e5-828-466.png
要想超载这些工具让他们的发射变得无比强大，需要从玩家的电池里汲取一些电力。这些电力除了可以超载武器，也可以用来超载一些“谜题”，直接跳过谜题交互完成任务，大幅加速任务进程。是把电力用在消灭敌人上，还是用在消灭解谜流程上，就看三人的配合了。
也正是这些风味化的设计，一定程度上拉开了与《绝地潜兵》等竞品的体验，找到了属于自己的风格。
强大的打工人，最终会赚个盆满钵满……吗
https://image.gcores.com/97399c4dbf1d47b383692268e8fafb95-828-466.png
最后，是与发行团队的一些简单沟通，以及我的一些思考。

在他们看来，这是一款想要塑造“蓝领英雄”的游戏，开发灵感来自许多作品，比如《捉鬼敢死队》《黑衣人》《异形》《绝世天劫》等。这些作品中的主角都不是超人，没有超能力——他们像《绝世天劫》里的蓝领工人一样，粗犷、务实，拥有厉害的技术和武器，对资本主义、权力和高层管理抱有不信任感。他们直率、甚至有些粗犷和暴力，但也非常可爱和直接。他们的生存环境是高压的打工环境——长时间工作、需要薪酬回报、不断加班、被资本主义压榨。这些乍一听似乎都能切中当下的时代性。
但是在两个小时不到的游玩里，由于游玩时间有限以及没能从头开始游戏，并没有太能感受到那种非常代入的，为黑心大企业卖命的氛围，主角三人所做的工作也没让我觉得充斥着所谓的“蓝领”气质。要想充分感受到这部分是否做的优秀，还得花更多时间游玩正式版本。
我对发行团队负责人说：《绝地潜兵2》以及其他同类游戏的成功并不在于他真的把战斗玩法做的多有趣，而是只要我打开游戏就能身临其境，为了“超级地球”或者“帝皇”，我就可以无数次再开一把这些游戏。如果《异克斯小队》在这方面下足功夫，那就能真正戳中我的好球区。
但话又说回来，我所举的这些例子的确也都是已经有许多年的社区耕耘之后的结果了。要想在这个赛道上用一个全新IP抢一杯羹，难度自然是相当大。
要想让玩家切实感受到与自己控制的打工人的共情和相互鼓励，一定要去找真正的打工人，去找各行各业一线奋战的真正打工人来取取经，了解他们的思考方式和工作上的困境，只有这样才能在氛围和叙事上闯出自己的一片天。
另外，这款游戏也有他自己的“绝活”，那就是在长线运营方面非常清晰的自我认知，他们决定狠狠的“卷”（误用）一把同行竞品们。
以目前发行方规划的想法是，这款游戏将会以每三个月为一个赛季，不同主题、不同运营活动；每六周一个Battle Pass，包含新皮肤、新武器、职业模块，以及多样化的活动等。
我认为，只要更新频率够快够勤，内容够多，玩家自然会愿意经常回来玩一玩。
最后，在售价方面，这款游戏的售价不会高于同类产品。
完整版暂时计划于明年发布，但综上所述，如果你是一个喜欢三人合作PVE动作射击游戏的玩家，这是一款值得保持关注和期待的作品，等到正式发售后可以再看一看。
https://image.gcores.com/61bea3ea4c1c1756197bc2011982efdd-828-466.png

news.title: 数毛社确定PS5版《GTA6》是30帧：R星技术力强无敌
news.summary: 《GTA6》最新加长版实机演示公开后，知名技术分析媒体Digital Foundry（数毛社）也对这段实机进行了详细分析，并给出了极高评价。

content.v: 《GTA6》最新加长版实机演示公开后，知名技术分析媒体Digital Foundry（数毛社）也对这段实机进行了详细分析，并给出了极高评价。
数毛社认为，《GTA6》展现出的技术规模在本世代主机游戏中非常罕见，甚至称其可能是他们见过的最令人印象深刻的实时渲染展示之一。
首先是玩家最关注的性能表现。根据数毛社分析，本次展示的《GTA6》运行于标准版PS5，游戏内部渲染分辨率约为1440p，最终输出至4K，并且没有明显证据表明使用了FSR 2或TAA等现代时间超分技术。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282225464237.webp
在帧率方面，本次实机基本稳定在30FPS，仅出现极少量单帧波动。数毛社认为，Rockstar显然将大量性能资源用于维持开放世界的规模、密度以及复杂模拟，因此PS5未来推出60FPS模式的可能性非常低。
画面表现则成为此次分析的最大亮点之一。
数毛社尤其称赞了《GTA6》的角色渲染效果。游戏中的头发拥有更加真实的物理模拟，能够呈现发丝从根部到发梢的动态变化；皮肤材质、高光、汗水以及妆容也更加接近真实效果。露西亚等角色在游戏过程中的表现，甚至达到了过去许多游戏过场动画才能实现的细节水平。
此外，《GTA6》大量采用光追技术强化光照与反射效果。城市室内外环境能够呈现更加自然的间接光照、颜色溢出以及反射效果，配合更加密集的NPC、车辆以及环境细节，让整个莱昂尼达呈现出更强的“真实世界”观感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282225531664.jpg
数毛社同时指出，《GTA6》并非单纯追求画面精度，其世界模拟规模同样非常惊人。大量NPC、车辆以及动态事件共同构成了更加复杂的开放世界生态，Rockstar似乎希望让NPC拥有更加丰富的行为反应和持续存在的状态。
当然，数毛社也指出了目前实机存在的一些问题。由于PS5版本采用约1440p的内部渲染分辨率，部分细节存在画面柔化、锯齿以及闪烁现象；光追反射在摄像机移动时也可能出现模糊、拖影和噪点。此外，Rockstar引擎长期存在的动画与镜头运动顿挫感，在《GTA6》中似乎仍然存在。
至于PS5 Pro版本，数毛社认为玩家可以期待更高的画面质量。得益于更强的GPU以及PSSR超分辨率技术，PS5 Pro理论上能够进一步提升游戏的画面清晰度以及光追效果，不过具体表现仍需等待Rockstar公布相关实机。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282226006916.webp

news.title: Gears Of War: E-Day 有一个受大逃杀启发的 PvP 模式，你可以在其中剥掉敌人的肉
news.summary: Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game,

content.v: Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game, and for Gears of War: E-Day , developers at The Coalition are looking to give fans plenty of options for online fun. While the game's new take on Horde mode is shaping up to be the ultimate battlefield for players to enter, fans of traditional deathmatches aren't being left out in the cold either. At Gamescom, The Coalition spoke to GameSpot about E-Day's new Crucible mode and how it uses some battle royale inspiration to create a fast-paced round of 4v4 action.

The PvP mode blends your typical Gears of War spatial control with battle royale mechanics, as teams must grab the Power Core, bring it to a designated active zone, and hold their position while the opposition closes in on them. The catch is that the Power Core restricts your mobility and limits which weapons you can use, meaning that your team will need to watch your back. The core stores a close-range electrical charge attack, and the carrier can unleash a charged blast at point-blank range to fry an enemy player, but this attack does have a long recharge time. Once the Power Core enters the scoring zone, it will begin to shrink. This, in turn, creates high-stakes zone pressure, forcing players into brutal standoffs as the space around them tightens.

"It's very obviously inspired by battle royale games, but it's on a Gear-sized PVP map," creative director Matt Searcy said to GameSpot. "At the beginning of the map, there's lots of mobility, teams are moving around, you're trading the Power Core back and forth. But as the map goes on, you see defensive teams start to build up a front around the player they're protecting. And then, in awesome Gears fashion, the thing you're going to hold puts you at a slight disadvantage. So we gave you a heavy weapon that's basically a giant battery pack, and if somebody gets close to you within a really tight range, you can strip all the flesh off their body with a charge attack."

Crucible is one of four PvP modes that will be available on launch day. The multiplayer options include traditional Team Deathmatch, Conquest, and Demolition, each of which has been reworked for E-Day. Team Deathmatch has a dynamic respawn system to move spawn locations closer to where fights are breaking out, Conquest puts its own spin on the classic King of the Hill experience, and Demolition revolves around teams planting bombs on enemy territory.

Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, and it'll also be a day-one release through Xbox Game Pass. For more on the game, you can read up on how The Coalition solved its biggest lore problem.

news.title: 《美末2》DLSS 5对比图曝光 AI滤镜味有点重
news.summary: 近日，有玩家通过泄露的英伟达相关文件，在《最后生还者2》中抢先试跑尚未正式上线的DLSS 5。画面开启前后的对比图曝光后，迅速引发…

content.v: 近日，有玩家通过泄露的英伟达相关文件，在《最后生还者2》中抢先试跑尚未正式上线的DLSS 5。画面开启前后的对比图曝光后，迅速引发玩家讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282201024958.webp
从对比效果来看，开启DLSS 5后，游戏画面在部分细节上的表现有所提升。布料纹理更加清晰锐利，阴影过渡更加柔和立体，角色皮肤以及整体光影效果也更接近真实质感，部分场景的照片级视觉效果更加明显。
开
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282201025775.webp
关
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282201022381.webp
开
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282201026254.webp
关
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282201036425.webp
开
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282201034883.webp
关
不过，DLSS 5带来的变化并非完全都是正面的。对比原版画面可以发现，角色的面部特征出现轻微变化，部分玩家认为存在明显的“AI美化”痕迹；同时，画面整体色彩饱和度有所降低，一些区域也出现了类似“AI滤镜”的过度处理效果。
目前玩家社区对此呈现出明显的两极评价。支持者认为，DLSS 5展现出的神经渲染潜力相当惊人，有望进一步推动游戏画面向真正的照片级真实感发展；
但批评者则认为，这种画质提升需要付出较大的性能代价，而且AI对人物面部和画面风格的主动干预，可能反而破坏开发者原本的美术表现。
需要注意的是，目前这些测试基于泄露文件的非官方实验版本，并不能代表DLSS 5最终正式版的实际效果。随着英伟达后续继续优化，这些问题是否能够得到改善，还有待正式版本上线后进一步观察。

news.title: 《巫师3重制版》NS2性能揭晓！最高40FPS
news.summary: 在科隆游戏展第三日的REDstreams直播中，CD Projekt Red正式公开了《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》Nintendo Switch 2版本的更多技术细节，涵…

content.v: 在科隆游戏展第三日的REDstreams直播中，CD Projekt Red正式公开了《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》Nintendo Switch 2版本的更多技术细节，涵盖分辨率、帧率表现及多样化的操控方式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282200238513.jpg
在掌机模式下，游戏将以720p分辨率运行，帧率在30至40FPS之间浮动，并支持VRR可变刷新率。
连接底座输出至电视时，目标分辨率为1080p，同样运行于30至40 FPS区间。据开发团队介绍，若使用支持120Hz刷新率 的电视，游戏表现可更接近40 FPS的上限。
操控方面，Switch 2版将充分利用主机的新特性：除便携模式、底座模式及双握把模式外，还将支持 Joy-Con 2鼠标操控、陀螺仪瞄准及触屏操作。设置菜单中已包含灵敏度调节、相机稳定、陀螺仪与传统操控的倒置选项等细化配置。
Mod支持是本作的另一亮点。CDPR表示，绝大部分PC版Mod将可在Switch 2上运行，但部分因任天堂平台规范及硬件限制（如8K纹理Mod）将无法使用。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282200294777.png
关于玩家关心的实体版发售问题，官方在直播中未作明确确认，仅回应称“新消息将在适当时机公布”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282200303665.png

news.title: 《NBA 2K27》对球场两端进行重大升级
news.titleEn: NBA 2K27 Is Making Major Upgrades to Both Ends of the Court

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/18/nbathumbmycareer-1787076223072.png
说实话，NBA 休赛期已经出现了足够多的情节曲折，足以填满 MyCAREER 过场动画。勒布朗·詹姆斯 (LeBron James) 奔赴费城，湖人队 (Lakers) 卷入了一场所有权闹剧，据称估值高达 125 亿美元，而维克多·文班亚马 (Victor Wembanyama) 从篮球界才华横溢的外星人变成了《NBA 2K27》的代言人。 2026-27赛季还没开始，我就已经叫暂停了。
幸运的是，新的《NBA 2K》即将推出，让我有事可做。在该系列的大型季前赛揭晓了几乎所有模式的细节之后，以下是我对我的篮球同胞们最应该兴奋的内容的氛围检查。
游戏玩法想要在攻防两端发挥作用
《NBA 2K27》提供了一个非常令人信服的案例，证明今年最大的变化并不是找到一个强大的招式并不断地使用它，直到我的对手愤怒退出。进攻端获得了新的玩具，包括上跨、下跨、动态上篮引擎和扩展的运球定制，让我能够更好地控制如何创造空间和攻击篮筐。
防守也没有把屁股放在板凳上。重新设计了举手防守，彻底修改了投篮比赛系统，扩大了防守界限，并且新的碰撞系统应该赋予身体对抗更多的分量。换句话说，《NBA 2K27》正试图让球场两端发挥作用，这对于那些曾经看过队友冲向三分线并认为防守是别人的问题的人来说听起来是个好消息。
MyCAREER 上了一堂历史课
MyCAREER 今年迎来了一个特别有趣的补充，有五个可玩的时代，让我能够在 NBA 历史上的不同时期建立篮球生涯。快速举例：我可以从 1984 年的“魔术 vs. 伯德时代”开始，持续数十年，一直到 2016 年的“斯蒂芬时代”。很好。
还有《Fire & Concrete》，这是一部由说唱歌手兼演员文斯·斯台普斯 (Vince Staples) 主演的 11 章电影故事。这是去年故事长度的两倍多，所以我的我的玩家应该有更多的时间来做出可疑的生活选择，同时穿着昂贵的数字服装看起来令人怀疑。
更棒的是，《NBA 2K27》首次引入了合作模式 MyCAREER。朋友可以通过《Running Mate Trace Miller》加入我的职业生涯，这意味着我终于可以分享苦衷，而不仅仅是在群聊中争论谁的构建被破坏了。
我的玩家可以在城市的活动中一起竞争。
Crew 玩家还获得了 Crew HQ 的新家，这里为练习、排名赛、私人比赛、Crew 晋级和季节性锦标赛提供了专用空间。与此同时，城市本身也因新的环境和活动而焕然一新，包括街头之王中的洛克公园、休闲角和每日对手。
发布时有 40 个 REP 等级，应该有足够的动力继续努力。我只需要记住，无论凌晨 2 点 47 分“再打一场比赛”的论点听起来多么有说服力，太阳最终还是会升起。
MyNBA 让我担任管理层
如果我对乐趣的看法是减少脚踝骨折和更多的电子表格，那么 MyNBA 将以回归基本的改革重返球场。该模式越来越关注其基本的特许经营系统，包括现实的 CBA 合同谈判和新的 GM 信托系统，这应该会让我的决定更有分量。
然后，MyNBA Legacy 的目标就变得非常雄心勃勃。这种新的单人 RPG 风格的体验让我可以在前台管理球队，同时也可以像同一个锁定的球员一样在球场上占据主导地位，而球队的窗口期长达 100 年。这足够的时间来建立一个王朝，摧毁它，重建它，然后想知道为什么我给了那个中锋一份七年的合同。
MyTEAM 希望每张牌都发挥作用
MyTEAM 也发生了一些重大的进展变化。交易所现在将接受我收藏中的任何玩家卡，让那些在我的阵容后面积攒虚拟灰尘的卡再次有机会为这一事业做出贡献。
全新的球员 XP 系统将让每张球员卡升级并解锁奖励，同时旋转多人游戏模式、统一的拍卖行、新的球员卡平行和扩展的突破进程增加了更多方式来构建、升级和玩我梦想的 NBA 和 WNBA 阵容。
本质上，我的板凳变得更深了。
W 和 MyWNBA 做主
《NBA 2K27》也为其 WNBA 模式提供了更多的发挥空间。 W 和 MyWNBA 都提供专门的单人游戏体验，以及随用随建的进度系统、更新的游戏属性系统以及新的团队徽章和队友徽章。

Those badges are designed to build chemistry and give me two distinct upgrade paths, while MyWNBA adds more tools for running a WNBA franchise from the front office. It's another sign that NBA 2K27 is treating its various forms of basketball as more than just different courts sharing the same ball.
MyPLAYER can travel with me

Perhaps the slickest quality-of-life addition is the new NBA 2K HQ companion app, which went live August 21. It lets you build and edit MyPLAYERs on the go before uploading those builds directly to my console, while QR-code sharing makes it easier to send builds to friends. The app also handles real-time messaging, Crew management, leaderboards and mobile-exclusive daily rewards. So even when I'm away from the console, the grind doesn't have to ride the pine.

Taken together, NBA 2K27 looks like a game that's trying to give every kind of hooper a reason to check back in. Whether I want to recreate basketball history, build a MyPLAYER, run a century-long franchise, collect cards, dominate The City or simply jump online with friends, there's a sizable menu of new plays to run.

And with the real NBA coming off an offseason featuring LeBron's move to Philly, the Lakers' ownership saga and a schedule that already has a Finals rematch lined up for Christmas Day, there's no shortage of inspiration.
NBA 2K27 tips off September 4, with Deluxe and Ultra Edition players getting an early start from August 27.

news.title: 侠盗猎车手 III – 遗产评论
news.summary: Replaying the pioneering 2001 classic 25 years later and paying tribute to the game that didn’t just change th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-3-legacy-review-thumb-1787907520325.png

Over the next few months, I’m going to be taking a look back at each of the core Grand Theft Auto games and replaying them in the lead-up to the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6. What we’ll be putting together won’t be traditional re-reviews, and they won’t come with any new IGN score, but they will re-examine what made each GTA remarkable upon the time of its release. By the end of the project, using GTA’s previously six-star wanted level, you should be able to get an idea of where each of these games roughly rank in my long-term love for this series.
Today, we go back to the game that changed this series forever: Grand Theft Auto III.

Playing Grand Theft Auto III in 2026 is a little like watching a home movie of Usain Bolt learning to walk. It’s a little wobbly, and it hasn’t quite got the whole process worked out yet, but through a modern lens it comes with a fascinating awareness you’re seeing the first steps of a field-defining juggernaut. In the late ’90s, GTA games had found success showing us the unique brand of freedom they offered within their sandbox-style cities – but the old school, top-down approach was a dated aesthetic in contrast to the fully 3D worlds that were first beginning to emerge during this era. In 2001, GTA III arrived as a completely different proposition, instantly reinventing the series as the new cutting edge of open-world action games.

It’s true that its already annoying targeting system is doubly frustrating by modern standards, and its time-consuming mission restarts do feel particularly punitive 25 years on. However, I’ve found it impossible not to admire how well it otherwise weaves together its driving, action, story, and exploration within a dynamic 3D world, considering it accomplished this before there was any sort of proper blueprint for doing so. Sure, GTA III didn’t get everything right immediately – but you’ve got to walk before you can run.

Playing GTA III in such close proximity to GTA 2, I’m actually quickly reminded of how immediately the former feels like the game that was actually teased by the latter’s eye-catching, live-action intro. The gritty, New York-based short promotional film Rockstar produced for GTA 2 (and subsequently trimmed down to serve as its intro) never felt remotely connected to the quasi-cyberpunk setting of that game – but it feels perfectly aligned to GTA III. The fact that GTA III made good on a cheque that GTA 2 bounced made it all the more special upon its arrival. GTA 2 only left me desperately wanting a game in the spirit of what I saw in that promo film. Two years later, GTA III delivered it.

GTA III kept a couple of noticeable elements established by its predecessor – like its hilarious array of custom radio commercials, its random fascination with Elvis Presley, and even an optional top-down camera – but it completely discarded its divisive time period, indeterminable location, and retro-futuristic fleet of vehicles. Instead, it opted for something credible, contemporary, and recognisable, and returned to the original GTA’s New York homage: Liberty City.
It’s a Bent World

While GTA III’s voice cast is a murderers’ row of iconic Hollywood crime fiction actors – including Frank Vincent, Michael Madsen, Joe Pantoliano, Robert Loggia, Michael Rapaport, Kyle MacLachlan, and Debi Mazar – none gallops away as the star of the game. In fact, with a silent protagonist and an otherwise very simple story propped up by a supporting crew of broad and largely one-dimensional criminal stereotypes, it’s Liberty City itself that perhaps emerges as GTA III’s greatest character.

Liberty City is split into three distinct boroughs that are rationed out as the story unfolds. We begin in Portland, an area defined by its grimy industrial sector and seedy red light district, before scampering to the Manhattan-inspired Staunton Island when the situation turns sour. Staunton Island is a wholly different backdrop; it’s highly commercial and features towering skyscrapers and a lush and centrally located park. The third area is Shoreside Vale, which is a leafy, suburban zone that’s otherwise dominated by a large airport and dam. Unfortunately, Shoreside Vale is actually the least interesting of the three boroughs, lacking both the personality of Portland and the density of Staunton Island. I’ll give it a nod for being the home of the infamously tricky to fly Dodo, but it’s otherwise a bit of a disappointing shift.

The dimensions of Liberty City are extremely modest compared to its later reinvention in GTA IV – and it’s absolutely dwarfed by modern open-world standards – but that was of no consequence back in 2001. At that time, it was unlike any game world we’d ever visited – and its nature as a place where day became night and clear weather turned to rain made it somewhere that felt alive in a fundamentally new way. Stand still in GTA III’s Liberty City and life will simply go on around you. Traffic flows, pedestrians pass, and the Earth spins. None of this would be particularly impressive today, but it was back then. The feeling I got re-immersing myself in GTA III and being transported back to that moment in my life has been a potent one.
You Better Drive, Brother

The template DMA Design established for the top-down GTA games unsurprisingly remained in place for GTA III. That is, whether you’re behind the wheel or on foot, everything happens in the same space. There are no “driving” levels or “action” levels. There are no levels at all. There’s one map, and player agency is the number one priority. Yes, there are many instances where the missions may compel you to use a particular vehicle but, for the most part, you’re in complete control of how you move around the world. Grab whatever car you want, and head in any direction you choose.

25 years on, the novelty of this freedom has somewhat expired – but in 2001 it was really nothing short of revolutionary. The powerful might of the PlayStation 2 had given GTA III the ability to push far beyond what was possible on the original PlayStation, transforming its top-down chaos into something modern, immediate, dangerous, and cinematic. Very simply, you were now in the world – not floating above it. It no longer felt like playing cops and robbers with toy cars – it felt like holidaying in a Michael Mann action sequence.

GTA III’s driving physics are a little slippier and floatier than they are in the more modern installments of the series, but they’re still quite easy to come to terms with in 2026. They don’t quite have the weight and inertia needed to be able to consistently flick them into extravagant J-turns and the like, but they feel otherwise adequate. There are many open-world action/driving games released over the last 25 years that I’ve found twitchier, sloppier, or more superficial than GTA III, that much I can assure you. At any rate, being behind the wheel is also the only way to hear all the wacky radio commercials, which once again had me grinning – or the cavalcade of insane callers on Chatterbox FM.

news.title: 《湮灭之潮》斩获科隆游戏展「最具史诗感」大奖：国产单机游戏惊艳世界舞台
news.summary: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（T

content.v: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（The Most Epic Game）大奖。这款出自成都团队的处女作，力压《红色沙漠》（Crimson Desert）、《战锤40K》（Warhammer 40K）等国际 IP 胜出。
https://image.gcores.com/8f3091b9195c56ec451b7df6a462c652-1920-1080.jpg
力压国际大作，成都团队首作扬威科隆
gamescom award 由德国数字游戏文化基金会主办，是全球最大游戏盛会科隆游戏展的官方奖项。值得关注的是，「最具史诗感」大奖的往届得主中不乏全球顶级 IP：《塞尔达传说》《怪物猎人：荒野》《生化危机：安魂曲》均曾摘得此桂冠，《湮灭之潮》此番能从中突围，含金量不言而喻。
https://image.gcores.com/6f322adaa6c36e6c890a01e2ddb057f7-1920-1281.jpg
继全新宣传片「旧日之纱」于开幕夜直播（Opening Night Live）首映、并于科隆展览中心 6 号馆 B-050 展位迎来公开试玩之后，本作凭借酣畅淋漓的战斗体验、电影级的演出品质、独特的幻影骑士系统与史诗级 Boss 战，征服了到场媒体与玩家。将亚瑟王传奇融入「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」的独特设定，正是这一殊荣的最佳注脚。
从格雯德琳的情感旅程，到召唤圆桌骑士对抗半神
“科隆游戏展是行业内最具影响力的展会之一。我们能在这里获得『最具史诗感』大奖，感到非常荣幸。”《湮灭之潮》游戏监制陈琦表示，“从开发之初，我们的目标就是以中国团队的视角，改编亚瑟王经典。这座奖杯，是对我们开发团队辛勤付出、创造力与热情的极大肯定。在众多优秀的提名作品能最终胜出，我们倍感鼓舞，不胜感激。”
https://image.gcores.com/76870173b85ba4181698cdf80977d605-1920-1441.jpg
自《黑神话：悟空》之后，《湮灭之潮》成为又一款在科隆游戏展斩获大奖的国产单机游戏。从成都东郊记忆的千人试玩会，到德国科隆 gamescom 的领奖台，《湮灭之潮》正将它的瑰奇幻想带向更广阔的世界。
https://image.gcores.com/c48a1cafea3c96ed52ba980d66d245fb-1920-1441.jpg
《湮灭之潮》是一款日蚀边缘工作室研发并发行的国产单机买断制骑士幻想动作冒险游戏。游戏基于虚幻 5 引擎打造，仅登录 PC 及主机平台，游戏以「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」为核心设定，玩家将扮演灾难中的幸存者格雯德琳（Gwendolyn），在现实与幻境交织的伦敦废墟中展开冒险，对抗由异世界而来的威胁，并逐步揭开世界倾覆背后的秘密。
《湮灭之潮》现正面向 PC（Steam 与 Epic Games Store）、PlayStation 及 XBOX 平台开发中。
https://image.gcores.com/3293e6e5999d7b92d0d6ab760cc0708e-1920-1437.jpg

日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）是一家面向全球玩家开发及发行 PC 和主机游戏的工作室，总部位于四川成都。工作室当前正在开发基于亚瑟王神话的动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，团队由 150 余名开发者组成，成员曾参与《如龙》（Yakuza）《荣耀战魂》（For Honor）《刺客信条》（Assassin's Creed）《女神异闻录》（Persona）与《波斯王子》（Prince of Persia）等知名游戏的研发。

news.title: 被Epic称为中国版战神！国内多家知名大厂投资合作

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564667.jpg
未来能否和国内顶尖单机坐一桌？
文/九莲宝灯
在今年的科隆Gamescom展上，有一款国产游戏引了葡萄君的注意——它就是来自 古神实验室的《古神：风里希》。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564679.gif
这款游戏在今年初，曾经曝光过一小段视频。当时，游戏展现出的特效、打斗，颇具3A感。但自那之后，游戏一直没有展开什么后续动作。因此，我一度以为这是某个小团队的玩票作品，因制作难度太大胎死腹中。
想不到，半年过去，他们突然活跃起来，游戏不仅在不久前的CJ上 放出了可试玩版本 ，这次科隆展还 直接 端出了新的PV 。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564671.jpg
相比于年初放出的内容，他们不仅大改了角色形象，游戏的战斗演出也明显华丽了不少，整体来看，我们已经能从中看出最终的发展方向。
于是，我找到了古神工作室负责人、游戏制作人 盘古刘大锤 ，和他聊了聊这款游戏的开发经历，以及幕后的团队故事。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564668.jpg
盘古刘大锤
这一聊我才发现，从人到团队再到项目，这个 古神实验室 真不简单：
刘大锤06年开始创业，他当时还在北理工读大二，团队参与研发的引擎就已经帮助08年奥运会开幕式做过人员调度工作。
后来他一边创业，一边在港理工读完了硕博，古神的核心团队也一路跟随，团队赚钱后，刘大锤曾给大伙分了房子。如今，他已在行业摸爬滚打了20年。
至于《古神：风里希》，这款游戏比我想象得更受业内重视。不仅有多家业内知名大厂参与了这款游戏的投资或合作，包括原力动画在内的多个曾参与哪吒系列电影的制作团队，也参与到了这款游戏的制作过程中。
刘大锤告诉我，他们的目标，是希望从这部作品开始，通过努力， 未来能坐上国产顶尖单机这一桌 。
但这也更让人好奇了：这家隐世老怪一样的工作室，过去20年到底都在做什么？为什么突然决定出山做单机大作了？他们到底又凭什么能被业界这么多人所重视？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564669.jpg
以下是葡萄君与古神工作室负责人刘大锤的对话内容，为方便阅读，调整为自述形式：
一款中国版《战神》？
我们这款游戏到底什么样？如果让我总结一个核心特点，就是「女娲造人，神仙打架」。
为什么是这8个字？
女娲造人，说的是我们游戏的世界观。作为一款以创世神话为题材的游戏，《古神：风里希》和女娲造人的故事是高度相关的。游戏的主角是女娲用泥土创造的「灵珠子」，她需要通过收集五脏六腑，通过各种修仙途径，从凡人变成神仙，最终达到法天象地的境界。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564670.jpg
神仙打架，说的是玩法。它可以分成好几个方面。
其次，神仙打架和凡人打架，在表现上也有很多不同。我们总结为三个，一是他们能够上天入地，二是他们拥有多样化的法宝，三是他们比凡人有更强的身体素质。
先说上天入地的部分。不管是游戏主角、还是游戏里的其他神仙，他们都能在空中飞行，打的是空地一体化战斗。角色可能会在天上遭遇，然后一路打到地上，也有可能出现空对地/地对空的情况。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564678.gif
这是我们最具独特性的地方，因为面对不同空间位置的敌人，你的对敌姿态、战斗方式也不一样，这意味着我们的战斗动作会非常的多样化。
然后是法宝。很多MMO之类的游戏里可能都有类似的设定，但那些法宝通常是塞背包里的，并不能外显，这样沉浸感就差了很多。我们希望这些法宝能够外显出来，玩家能够看到这些法宝在角色身上。
但这又会带来一个问题：各种各样的法宝背在背后，看着乱七八糟的，不够帅。所以我们就想到一个点子：这些法宝不用的时候，是像衣服一样穿在身上的。
比如哪吒常用的法宝。混天绫平时就是角色的衣服，火尖枪会变成臂甲，风火轮就是腿甲。进入战斗的时候，法宝会从身上脱落，这还能让角色有一种「爆衣」的感觉。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564683.gif
我们还专门按照不同法宝的作用，做了各种特效。为了确保这些法宝能给人强大的感觉，我们还专门去找了《战神》系列游戏和《哪吒》系列动画的制作团队深度合作，把一些影视级的流体、破碎、粒子光照等技术移植到游戏引擎上来。
最后就是神仙的身体素质这方面。神仙打架是比较「体面」的，他们不能直接在地上打滚，通常要先斗法，最后才会伤害到身体。所以我们给这些神仙设计了神力架势条，玩家要先打破这个架势条，才能进入肉搏的阶段。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564672.jpg
到了这个环节，我们希望给玩家爽感。这个游戏本身的战斗门槛其实设计得比较低，玩家上手是很轻松的，不仅如此，我们还会在战斗体验上追求《战神》风格，往爽快华丽的方向做。我们在游戏中还做了大量受击反馈，你用不同的战斗动作攻击敌人，它们的反馈都不一样，保证单位时间内的情绪体验价值拉满。
这里值得扩展一下的是，我们在视觉感受上的设计思路也是一样的。我们计划在游戏中加入很多奇观巨兽，给人最直接的视觉爽感。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564674.jpg
为了给玩家带来这些感受，我们对技术做了很多突破。
像是空地一体化战斗，我们用了Motion Matching 2.0技术，它能让角色在地面与空中展现出各种姿态，并且这些姿态可以无缝切换。这项技术带来的动画AI推演能力，还能让角色在空中冲刺、法宝释放、以不同力度落地时，都有实时物理反馈。
再比如动画反馈。我们在这里用了ML Deformer/Neural morph技术进行实时推理，它能替代传统物理骨骼实时解算，速度提升1000倍。这样一来，角色受击的时候，肌肉、脂肪抖动才能很真实。这种细节能给玩家带来更强烈的视觉刺激。
为了做出更符合我们心中的神仙打架的特效，我们也在流体力学、程序化破碎、体积光方面有技术突破。之前CJ，我也做了一场CGDC技术讲座，讲的是电影级流体解算的游戏应用。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564673.jpg
总之，《古神：风里希》是一款想要主打爽快感和愉悦感的游戏，我们不想在游戏里讲太冗长的剧情，也不希望它变成让人受苦的魂游。我们的一切目标都是让玩家在游玩过程中能收获充分的视觉愉悦感和畅快的体验。
我们最终想做的，其实是有自己特色的中国创世神话版《战神》。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564676.jpg
大学生创业： 自研引擎，做MMO？
我从业已经超过20年了，见过无数黄掉的公司和项目，我们团队可以说是从死人堆里爬出来的。我们穿越过国内端游、手游、3A的流行浪潮，经历过各种高峰和低谷，才艰难活到第三个10年周期。
从创立至今，我们的产品有好有坏，这也让团队多次陷入挣扎。团队能坚持20年，关键可能在于我们的技术基因。
如果不是早年对技术的执念，现在做《古神：风里希》，这些神仙打架的场景包含各种大尺度的空间运动和华丽的特效，没有技术不可能搞得定。
核心团队是2006年在北京理工大学成立的。我当时学的是数字媒体专业，到大二的时候，我已经把学校图书馆里所有和游戏沾边的书全看完了。随后，我拿着大概几千块钱的微软奖学金，就想着组建团队。
为了让人加入我的团队并不容易。我们公司现在的艺术总监，当时是我的师兄，我几乎每天都跑到他的宿舍和他探讨游戏，可以说是三十顾茅庐，最终才说动他加入团队。团队里的每一个人，几乎都是这样一个个找来的。
团队组建好之后，我们计划打造一套属于中国的创世故事，把盘古开天、女娲补天造人等上古传说，用一条连贯线性叙事脉络串联起来。我们很快就拿出了一款基于这套内容的MMORPG，让玩家在上古星球中生存游历。它叫《盘古Online》。
这款游戏有很多遗憾。我们用的是自研引擎，受限于当年的技术和经验，即便我们花了很多心思去搭建完整大世界，设计游玩框架，但游戏整体还是算不上成熟，也没有吸引到太多玩家。
不过当时大学生自研引擎做MMO还是很新鲜的事情，包括新华社、人民日报在内的很多媒体都报道了我们的作品。
当年的开发团队

news.title: 孙亚龙力挺景甜：一看就是好女孩 拉手都会脸通红
news.summary: 近期，演员景甜与加密货币富商孙宇晨之间的金钱与情感纠纷持续发酵，也在网络上引发了广泛关注与讨论。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282126407252.png
近期，演员景甜与加密货币富商孙宇晨之间的金钱与情感纠纷持续发酵，也在网络上引发了广泛关注与讨论。
据悉，孙宇晨已通过代理律师对景甜及其父母提起民事诉讼，要求返还合计超过3000万元人民币的彩礼及相关款项。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282127012720.png
对此，前《英雄联盟》职业选手孙亚龙（笑笑）在微博公开发声，力挺景甜，称其为“好女孩儿”。他转发景甜回应长文并评价道：“一看就是拉手都会脸通红的”，表达对景甜人品的认可。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282127102837.png
孙亚龙还以自身经历暗讽孙宇晨。他表示，自己当年离婚时不仅没有追回彩礼，反而额外拿出300万元赠予前妻，只为对方未来能过得更好。他借此事调侃道：“孙割之间亦有差距。”暗指同为孙姓人士，对待感情与金钱的态度却截然不同。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282127114292.png

news.title: "30岁没老婆"成定型文！很焦虑 人崩溃了

content.v: 我40岁了，没有老婆，也没有成家，没有不良习惯，也不抽烟也不喝酒，也不赌博，也没有房贷，也没有车贷，没有负债，也没有网贷，目前一个人生活，想成家太难了，实在没办法了，以后家里也没有人了，无儿无女，以后就没有人养老了，如今又很焦虑，人也崩溃了，又是难搞的一天啊。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564537.jpg
以上这些话，如果你真的认真看完了，那么恭喜你，你在这过去的 短短10秒 里，我就已经成功帮你节约了 整整两年多 的时间，不用谢。
没有老婆太难了
一个男人，一个忧郁的男人，一个面无表情的男人，呆呆地坐在床尾，穿着一件洗的已经发皱的黑色或灰色的衣服，身旁摆放着一台 蓝色的电风扇 ，身后的窗子即使外面阳光明媚，也被层层叠叠的衣服遮挡住了阳光。
脸上的表情，是看破一切的麻木，以及对生活失去希望的迷茫。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564542.jpg
（提问：电风扇为什么是蓝色的？）
伴随着名为“忧伤的咪嗦啦”钢琴曲作为背景音乐，在噔噔噔噔噔~噔噔~的舒缓节奏下，男人缓缓的将上文这一整段话娓娓道来，并将各个关键词排列组合。
但不管这天发生了什么事情，这些词怎么排列，核心思想永远都只有一句话： 没有老婆 ；
今天炒了2块钱的红薯叶吃，但是我没有老婆。
今天做了个白切鸡改善伙食，但是我没有老婆。
今天发了工资有四千多块钱，但是我没有老婆。
今天生病了只能躺在医院里，但是我没有老婆。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564538.jpg
而因为这句话重复了太多太多次，以至于配合上某些画面产生了一些不可描述的和谐感，你知道我想说什么，我也知道你想说什么，但是都憋说嗷。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564539.jpg
（没办法就是没办法）
总之在“南瓜乔哥”的视频里，你会发现这世间的一切烦恼和生活的所有意义都可以归结为两个字 “老婆” 。
而没有老婆的他人生就没有了色彩、失去了光明、失去了动力，一个 40岁无不良嗜好的老实中年男性之殇 在乔哥的视频中体现的淋漓尽致。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564540.jpg
如果这样的一个视频你只是第一次看到，或许也会觉得这可能又是一个中年人在互联网上 自娱自乐 ，拍点日常视频发到网上，试图让不知道哪里出现的网友点上个位数的赞并留下几个评论。
但这段话在“南瓜乔哥”这里，只有 “日常视频” 这四个字是正确的！
因为从24年4月9日开始，这两年里乔哥真的是以 几乎每天一个视频 的速度持续不断地向中国互联网发散着自己娶不到老婆的怨气，2年时间一共更新了 615个 视频！
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564541.jpg
在最开始的时候，乔哥没有正经工作，每天躺在小出租屋的铁架床上等待日结工作。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564545.jpg
在一次视频中他讲述了自己的经历，农村长大的他初来广东，就被花花世界迷了眼，年轻的时候每个月工资都拿来吃喝玩乐，以至于整整 19年间 都没有存下来什么钱。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564548.jpg
于是，没有钱就没有老婆、没有老婆就没有生活的意义、没有生活的意义就没有动力赚钱、没有钱就没有老婆……最后得出结论， 人生毫无意义。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564544.jpg
总之在38岁那年，乔哥发现人生在世除了找老婆之外，另一件要事便是在互联网上找老婆。
而根据视频时间推测，在24年12月份，乔哥应该是过完了自己的39岁生日，但很遗憾的是，那年他没找到老婆。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564573.jpg
于是在25年5月份， 乔哥悟了。
世间扰扰，尘念浮沉。
情丝如麻，牵绊难断。
红粉本骷髅之相，凡乱我乔哥心者，皆是虚妄外缘，当以禅心照破，不被色相所迷。
静心修炼，望早日成佛。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564543.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564549.jpg
但是没办法，没有老婆太难了。
这趟佛门苦修就坚持了5天，但是要知道唐僧西行也才经历了6次色欲道心考验，咱们乔哥也算得上是一步之差，最后一天没忍住，可惜。
不过先别急，就算到了今年40岁了，乔哥也还可以继续尝试这条伟大的“问心”之路。
因为他还是没有老婆。
也是在这一年，乔哥正式在互联网上确立了自己的视频风格：先是一段“没有老婆贯口”，然后开始做菜吃饭，某种意义上来说，也算是一种吃播了。
但说实话，不会有人看到首页这 清一色复制黏贴的视频封面 还能绷得住吧？
AAA恩师南瓜乔哥
总而言之，虽然听起来很抽象，但是在“无儿无女无老婆”这条赛道上，乔哥确实成为了开创者。
这条赛道很挤，但人真的很多。
随着越来越多的年轻人开始刷到乔哥的这些视频，他们很难理解一个40岁的中年男人为什么能够孜孜不倦的在互联网上输出找老婆小视频，但能理解的是，这种事情真的很抽象。
而且最关键的一点是， 这种视频真的很好拍。
一台手机，一张床，一个人，有条件的可以加上一台电风扇，年轻人就可以开始自己的抽象大业，并感谢乔哥开源。

news.title: 《巫师3重制版》内存要求翻倍 老电脑瑟瑟发抖
news.summary: CD Projekt Red已公布《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》的PC系统配置要求，相比原版有所提升。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282117472666.png
CD Projekt Red已公布《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》的PC系统配置要求，相比原版有所提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282117547924.png
最低配置要求12GB内存，官方推荐16GB内存以获得更佳体验。同时，游戏需要安装至SSD，并预留至少70GB可用空间。此外，如果玩家仍在使用旧版操作系统，需升级至Windows 11方可运行。
目前升级PC并非理想时机。由AI数据中心驱动的全球内存短缺仍在持续，美国政府也在酝酿对半导体相关商品加征更多关税。不过，玩家不必担心重制版发售后会被“卡在门外”——玩家仍可选择不升级至重制版，继续游玩原版《巫师3》。.
《巫师3：狂猎》会提供了一个选项，可以将游戏回滚此前版本，而不是升级版。这对于使用性能较低的电脑或Steam Deck等掌机的玩家来说尤其方便。

news.title: Sabre回应拼车游戏中人工智能的批评并承诺，“我们永远不会解雇某人并用人工智能取代他们”
news.summary: One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative

content.v: One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative AI. It's a hot-button issue, and few companies have faced the level of criticism about it as Saber has. The developer recently found itself in hot water after CEO Matthew Karch lashed out at Rideshare Stimulator's former writer who said they were laid off and replaced by ChatGPT.
Now, Saber's chief creative officer, Tim Willits, has addressed the situation as well, promising that, "We will never fire someone and replace them with AI."

For anyone just catching up, Rideshare Stimulator is an upcoming Saber game where players take on the role of an Uber- or Lyft-like driver and interact with them as they take them to their location. The developers freely admit to using generative AI in various capacities, and now Willits has shed more light on the situation. He said the game's main campaign features dialogue written by humans, but there is also a "free ride" mode where Rideshare Stimulator wants to be able to reference current events in the real world.
"We use AI to generate that because we want to do it so fast," Willits said, adding that the plan is for weekly or biweekly updates with this kind of AI-generated content.

Willits also clarified that some of Saber's other games, including the new Hellraiser, Turok, Stuntman, and Space Marine games, also do not use AI. Saber, like many other game companies, is experimenting with AI in various ways.

"We want to figure this new technology out, and we don't know exactly where it's gonna go, and our players don't know where it's gonna go, so we're all ... all of us are trying as a society to figure this out together," he said. "We want to experiment with it. I personally believe somebody [at] some game company will come up with such a brilliant idea, and we'll all be like, 'That's it.' We just need to get there."

When asked specifically about claims that Saber is firing people and replacing them with AI, Willits said this is not true. "I promise you we have never let anyone go and replaced them with AI. We hire people all the time," he said.

A spokesperson for Saber previously told PC Gamer that neither Saber nor Rideshare developer Unigine replaced any writers with AI for that game or any others. "In fact, Saber's staff of writers has tripled since 2023. Rideshare's story was written entirely by real people," the company said.
Rideshare's "experimental, free-ride mode" does use generative AI "by necessity," Saber said, because "the number of passengers in the game is infinite."

"We are firm believers in using AI tools to improve or enhance gameplay experiences and improve NPC behavior as we have done since Saber was founded in 2001. As the industry has continued to contract, Saber continues to hire. None of our 3000+ employees have to worry about being replaced by AI," the developer said.

The writer in question, Stella Sacco, said Karch reached out to "apologize unreservedly" for how he spoke about Sacco. Karch had said , "Stella who? I had to ask Claude because I have never spoken to her or seen her."
Sacco added in a statement that Karch said "he regretted escalating and how people online were speaking about me."

"I'm not worried about being called slurs by random commenters--I'm a trans woman; that's every day for me. But it stunk to have my skill and reputation built of 20 years in games publicly maligned by someone with institutional power."

news.title: Hellraiser：复兴不仅仅是修士和血腥——我们从 Saber Interactive 学到的 10 件事
news.summary: October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrif

content.v: October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrifying-- and horny --dive into the nightmarish fiction of author Clive Barker. So far, the game is looking like the kind of Hellraiser experience that defined the franchise throughout the '80s and early '90s, and at Gamescom, Saber Interactive sat down with GameSpot to talk about the game, how far they're willing to go to nail the vibe of Hellraiser , and more.
Hellraiser: Revival launches for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 6.
Cliver Barker was a "permissive" partner

The legendary creator of Hellraiser needed some convincing before he started collaborating with Saber Interactive, but once he was assured that the developers had a grasp of the Hellraiser franchise, he gave the studio the freedom to tell their own tale within that dark universe. "Clive Barker was such a permissive partner to work with," narrative director Anthony De Fault said. "He was really supportive of our ideas. He basically just wanted to make sure we understood Hellraiser as a franchise, and then, once he knew that we had the, we were channeling the same spirit that he was channeling back in the '80s, he just let us go."
Capturing the soul of Hellraiser's greatest hits

For the game, Saber Interactive aimed to capture the "soul" of the franchise, drawing not only from the recognizable visual elements established in the Hellraiser movies, but also from Clive Barker's original novella, The Hellbound Heart, which served as the source material for the franchise. "This game is a response, specifically to The Hellbound Heart, the first film, and Hellbound: Hellraiser 2, the second film," de Fault said. "So it's just the things that Clive was involved with that resonated really strongly with people back then. We wanted to make something that renewed that and had the same soul, but for a new medium and 40 years later."

Barker was also credited as an executive producer on the third and fourth Hellraiser movies, but had no active production or creative involvement in the franchise until 2022's Hellraiser reboot. That gap saw six Hellraiser movies released, although fans usually consider this period a low point for the franchise.
Saber Interactive isn't afraid of pushing ratings boards to the limits

From what we've seen so far, Hellraiser: Revival looks like it'll be going all in on the extreme subject matter of Barker's work. Saber Interactive has confirmed that the game is going to be gory and sexy, as the studio didn't want to compromise on their vision--even if that meant it faced the risk of being denied classification in several regions. Why go that far? Because doing anything less was seen as a disservice to Hellraiser fans.

"We knew what Hellraiser ought to be. We knew how disappointed Hellraiser fans would be if we did compromise, so it was just never really on the table," de Fault explained. "We wanted to pitch it at a point where I don't know if the executives would necessarily have agreed with this at the time, but we always felt like, if we get denied a rating in one or two places, we've probably done our job right. It was just important to us to do everything with purpose. All of the depraved stuff that you might encounter in the game, I think everything in there is defensible in terms of there's a reason it's there. It's not just for shock value. "It's like a good discomfort."
"Comforting discomfort," Esov added. So far, it looks like the game will be available in the US, at least, as it has received an ESRB rating .
It was all about execution

While all of that comforting discomfort is designed with a purpose in mind, don't be too surprised if Hellraiser: Revival makes you reach for a bucket. One scene in particular might be hard to stomach, as de Fault described it as a moment of "consensual mutilation" in the game.

"There's a consensual mutilation scene. In early versions of this, we failed to adequately convey to players that this was consensual. So, some people came away thinking it wasn't and that it was pretty distressing, and so we had to course-correct that. I think our intent was fully realized in the game. There wasn't really anything we wanted to do that we scaled back or anything like that. We just had to correct the execution in some places."
Hellraiser: Revival takes place in the ancient year of 2006

Hellraiser: Revival is set in 2006, in the small town of Claireport. Saber Interactive chose this time period as a bridge between '80s Hellraiser and the modern era, while also ensuring there wouldn't be any "super high-techy stuff" to distract players. "We still wanted it to feel like an older franchise, but just without going all the way back to the '80s," de Fault added.
Pinhead has an agenda

Like most Hellraiser movies, Revival revolves around a pair of sex freaks who get more than they bargained for when they use one of the infamous puzzle boxes created by the Cenobites--the all-new Genesis Configuration in this instance. Playing as Aiden, it'll be up to players to rescue his girlfriend Sunny from the Cenobites, and you can expect to run into Pinhead at several points in the story.

"He plays a really substantial role," de Fault explained. He appears near the start of the game with all the other Cenobites, responding to the fact that Aiden and his girlfriend, Sunny, have used one of the configuration boxes from the game during their sexual play. In Hellraiser fashion, [the Cenobites] demand a soul, and they take somebody away who happens to be Sunny. "I probably shouldn't go further than that, but Pinhead, you encounter him multiple times. The deal that you have with him has its twists and turns, and it evolves."
Pinhead is also voiced by Doug Bradley, the actor who played him in several Hellraiser movies over the decades.
The "Genesis Configuration" box is fueled by suffering

While previous Hellraiser media revolved around the Lament Configuration puzzle box, the Genesis Configuration is a completely new creation for the game. It serves as both a plot device and a weapon, but to use it, you'll need to fuel it with the suffering of enemies and Aiden's own anguish. Saber Interactive isn't spilling the beans on how it fits into the overall story of Hellraiser: Revival, but they did tease that it was made for a specific purpose that will be revealed eventually.

"It's all in the name of this glorified violence, and basically, it gets powered by the suffering of yours and others," game director Emil Esov explained. "When there is suffering in the vicinity, you get more energy into the box, and you can perform these abilities."
Cenobites can't be trusted

Don't expect to be taking on iconic Cenobites in Hellraiser: Revival. They serve a variety of roles in the game, helping Aiden to unlock new powers for the Genesis Configuration or acting as unstoppable antagonists you'll have to escape. The female Cenobite--sometimes referred to as the Fallen because she was a nun who was drawn to sin in her human life--will also serve as a devil on Aiden's shoulder when she's not unlocking new powers for the Genesis Configuration.

content.v: 由 Coin Crew Games 开发、iam8bit Presents 发行的合作解谜游戏《逃脱学院2：再返校园》（Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School）公开了更多游戏内容。随着最新试玩版本在德国科隆展的开放，玩家现在得以进一步了解游戏前两个章节的冒险，并首次深入此前尚未展示的科学校区。
作为获奖解谜游戏《逃脱学院》的正统续作，《逃脱学院2：再返校园》并不满足于简单地增加更多密室，而是将系列原有的密室逃脱玩法扩展至一座可以自由探索的巨大校园，试图打造一款真正意义上的“开放世界密室逃脱游戏”。
前作已经吸引超过400万名玩家体验，而这一次，无论是第一次入学的新生，还是准备“再返校园”的老同学，都将面对一所规模更大、秘密更多，也更加危险的逃脱学院。
如需了解更多关于游戏的资讯和福利，欢迎加入逃脱学院2：再返校园的官方QQ群：2163072443
第二章首次公开：前往科学校区！
完成校园中的一系列任务后，游戏将正式进入第二章。这一次，玩家需要前往学院的科学校区，并在那里与一位全新角色——Von Bellini教授会合。
科学校区的前期内容包含两个入门级谜题房间，而目前可以公开展示的内容已经覆盖至化学实验室谜题完成。顾名思义，这一次的“课程”将把科学实验与密室解谜结合起来。
观察环境、寻找线索、理解机关之间的联系，再利用手边能够找到的一切想办法解决问题——虽然校园变得更加开放，但系列最核心的“密室逃脱感”并没有消失，而是被进一步融入了不同学院、课程和校园环境之中。至于化学实验室之后还会发生什么？为了避免剧透，我们还是把答案留到正式上课之后吧。
https://image.gcores.com/526e9e51efbc57e0d56c862f90f2cdc1-1268-714.jpeg
科学之外还有艺术！欢迎来到艺术校区
除了目前试玩能够接触到的内容，开发团队近期还通过开发日志进一步展示了另一片极具特色的区域——艺术校区。与科学校区截然不同，艺术校区在视觉设计上大量参考了西班牙建筑风格。
彩色灰泥墙、陶土瓦片、铁艺阳台与栏杆、手绘招牌以及砖石路面共同构成了整个区域，而随处可见的颜料飞溅痕迹、壁画、涂鸦与雕塑，则不断提醒玩家：这里教授的，是逃脱的“艺术”。
整个艺术校区沿着陡峭的山坡与海岸悬崖层层向下展开。山顶坐落着Hall of Escapists与Workshop，层叠式阶梯一路向下延伸，将一个个工作室与教室连接起来，形成了一座依山而建的小型艺术村落。
其中一些值得关注的地点包括：
The Monument of Escape
服装店
舞蹈工作室
剧院
当然，开发团队目前还没有准备让我们看清这些建筑内部究竟藏着什么。
https://image.gcores.com/d1ad493b120f6d825d2a8a69a152e90a-1268-714.jpeg
一位有点吓人的艺术教授
负责艺术校区大部分课程的是 Enora Chortkoff教授。而“严格”，可能都是一个比较温和的形容。Enora年轻时曾被The Showman's Studio的一场演出深深吸引，并从此梦想着有一天能够亲自站上那个舞台。
她开始把几乎所有业余时间投入到表演艺术中——看戏、写剧本，并不断训练自己掌握的各种表演技巧。《逃脱学院2：再返校园》的故事发生在她人生最大失败的10年之后。当年，Enora终于获得机会，在Jacob Surovskey著名的谋杀悬疑剧《The Death of the Artist》中饰演Ruby LeClue。然而，她过于执着于让自己的表演达到“完美”，反而忘记了真正重要的事情：把它演好。
那次失败让她再也不敢站在观众面前。后来，Solange向她伸出了手，邀请她来到逃脱学院，成为这里的表演艺术教授。于是如今的学生们，也终于有机会亲自感受Enora教授对于“艺术”的严格要求。
https://image.gcores.com/6fbeba0d748328254d66fdc9feec4054-1268-714.jpeg
一个人动脑，还是两个人一起“坐牢”？
和前作一样，《逃脱学院2：再返校园》依然可以完整单人游玩，但合作体验也是本作的重要组成部分。游戏全部内容均支持在线双人合作以及本地分屏合作，玩家可以叫上一名同学共同探索校园、交换自己发现的线索，并一起挑战各种精心设计的逃脱房间。
对于不喜欢在倒计时压力下解谜的玩家，本作还加入了全新的可选“无计时模式”。不管是经验丰富的解谜高手，还是第一次接触密室逃脱的新生，都可以选择适合自己的节奏完成课程。
与此同时，初代负责音乐的 DJ Doseone 也将回归，为这场校园生活带来一系列全新的音乐。《逃脱学院2：再返校园》将登陆 PC、Xbox Series X|S与Xbox One 平台。游戏试玩版目前已可在Steam体验。

news.title: 心理生存恐怖游戏《Holstin》确定2027年登陆PC及主机
news.summary: Team17与开发商Sonka今日宣布，备受期待的心理生存恐怖游戏 《Holstin》 将于 2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并将在发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass 。 <内嵌内容，请前往机核查看> 游戏故事发生在

content.v: Team17与开发商Sonka今日宣布，备受期待的心理生存恐怖游戏 《Holstin》 将于2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并将在发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass。
游戏故事发生在20世纪90年代初，一座与世隔绝、正在逐渐腐朽的波兰小镇遭到某种未知且不可见的恐怖力量侵蚀。《Holstin》将经典生存恐怖游戏的独特氛围与极具辨识度的背景设定和美术风格相结合，为玩家呈现一场阴暗而诡异的生存之旅。
https://image.gcores.com/c051157de9ed9f00d9ea307c0c84b5d0-1268-714.jpeg
独特2XD渲染技术，在像素世界中自由切换视角
《Holstin》采用Sonka自主研发的 2XD Rendering技术，通过实时光照和动态镜头视角，让这个阴森诡异的像素世界真正“活”起来。
玩家可以在8个不同角度之间旋转镜头，探索Jeziorne-Kolonia小镇每一个被黏液覆盖的角落，并根据不同场景无缝切换游戏视角。
游戏包含多种截然不同的表现方式，包括：
等距3D视角
激烈战斗中的越肩视角
驾驶车辆时的第一人称视角
俯视角探索
横版平台动作
多种视角和玩法形式相互结合，创造出在像素风格游戏中极为少见的视觉体验。
深入被诅咒的波兰小镇，寻找失踪的好友
游戏讲述了主人公 Tomasz Wolanski 的故事。
为了寻找自己失踪的好友，他来到坐落于湖畔乡间的小镇 Jeziorne-Kolonia。他的好友是一名调查记者，最后一次被人看到正是在这里。
然而，当Tomasz真正踏入小镇后，他很快发现这里已经被某种难以名状的恐怖力量所笼罩。
想要从游荡在被诅咒小镇中的怪物手下活下来，玩家必须不断搜寻武器、补给以及任何可能帮助Tomasz生存下去的物资。
怪物却并不是这里唯一的危险。
小镇中为数不多的幸存居民也在逐渐失去理智。玩家需要顺着他们越来越严重的妄想与其交流。如果能够获得这些居民的信任，他们或许会提供重要线索以及解开谜题所需要的信息。
但想要揭开他们隐藏的秘密，则需要玩家更加谨慎、机敏地与他们周旋。
https://image.gcores.com/65c15f0d3edf1e6dafe6f1557f7019f6-1268-714.jpeg
重现90年代后苏联时代东欧风貌
《Holstin》致力于还原20世纪90年代后苏联时代东欧地区的独特面貌与氛围，其中尤其聚焦于波兰。
从Jeziorne-Kolonia小镇中的家具和日常用品，到商品品牌、标识、建筑与室内设计，每一个细节都经过精心设计，以重现那个时代。
褪色的墙纸、破旧的家用电器、年代久远的广告以及随处可见的日常用品共同构成了这个世界，让玩家即使观察最微小的角落，也能够感受到浓郁的时代气息。
与此同时，游戏将提供完整的波兰语及英语配音，玩家可以选择自己喜欢的语言体验这个陌生而又令人不安的世界。
波兰另类摇滚乐队Heima打造原声音乐
《Holstin》诡异压抑的氛围还将通过专门为游戏创作的音乐进一步得到强化。
游戏原声由波兰另类摇滚乐队Heima负责创作，在阴森诡异之余又带有令人平静的独特气质，并包含完整的波兰语人声演唱及歌词。
乐队近期已经发布了游戏原声中的首支单曲——《Skaza》，目前已登陆各大主流音乐流媒体平台。
Steam试玩版现已开放，94%特别好评
等不及2027年正式发售？现在就可以亲自踏入Jeziorne-Kolonia。
《Holstin》目前已经在Steam推出免费试玩版，胆量足够的玩家可以亲自体验游戏开头约两个小时的内容。
目前试玩版已经在Steam获得500多篇玩家评测，其中94%为好评，整体评价达到“特别好评”。
《Holstin》将于2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并于发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass。
https://image.gcores.com/2b5daca511d817e08baa33eedca4f330-1268-714.jpeg

news.title: 《GTA6》对比前作全方位碾压！13年前神作再进化
news.summary: 知名游戏对比分析频道ElAnalistaDeBits近日发布了一段长达18分钟的对比视频，将《GTA6》最新27分钟实机演示与13年前的前作进行了同…

content.v: 知名游戏对比分析频道ElAnalistaDeBits近日发布了一段长达18分钟的对比视频，将《GTA6》最新27分钟实机演示与13年前的前作进行了同屏对照。视频涵盖驾驶、人物建模、车辆追逐、战斗等多个维度，直观展现了Rockstar两代作品在技术与视觉表现上的跨世代进步。
对比视频：
在光影与反射方面，《GTA6》采用了更先进的全局光照与反射系统。无论是车载后视镜、建筑玻璃幕墙，还是酒吧内部的霓虹灯光，反射层次都更加自然柔和，阴影过渡也更为细腻。
在车辆物理与碰撞表现上，视频对比了高速公路追逐与撞击场景。《GTA6》展现出更真实的重量感、悬挂起伏，以及子弹命中或碰撞时车身钣金凹陷、碎片飞散等细节，整体真实感明显提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282008578490.jpg
该对比视频发布后引发玩家热烈讨论，绝大多数观众表示，尽管前作凭借多次重制与更新至今仍具可玩性，但与《GTA6》同屏对比后，依然能直观感受到十年技术进步带来的巨大飞跃，尤其是在光影表现和角色建模方面。

content.v: Have your say.
Nintendo Switch 2 has now had well over a year to bed in as a platform, and sales figures suggest that it's doing rather well.

In fact, with 23.68 million units sold as of 30th June 2026 — surpassing GameCube's lifetime sales in just over one year and trending better than the original Switch in its first year — you could say it's doing extremely well, especially given all the economic obstacles and industry strife right now. news.title: 自由落体25分钟！iPhone从3万米高空掉落竟毫发无伤
news.summary: 手机配件品牌犀牛盾（RhinoShield）近日联手航天公司Sent Into Space，为其AirX手机壳进行了一次前所未有的极限跌落测试。

content.v: 手机配件品牌犀牛盾（RhinoShield）近日联手航天公司Sent Into Space，为其AirX手机壳进行了一次前所未有的极限跌落测试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281944014861.png
6月24日，团队在瑞典基律纳上空将一部iPhone 17 Pro通过高空气球携带至 30,607米（约100,418英尺） 的高空——超过民航客机巡航高度的三倍——随后将其释放。
在没有降落伞、加热系统或任何额外保护的情况下，手机在 近零下60摄氏度 的低温中经历了约25分钟的自由落体，最终降落在瑞典偏远的荒野中。吉尼斯世界纪录官方要求手机壳本身必须首先与地面接触，而AirX手机壳完美满足了这一条件。回收后，手机可正常开关机、拨打电话并拍摄照片，机身无任何可见损伤。
吉尼斯官方认证团队事后花费超过5小时才在约2公里的搜索范围内找到坠落设备。此次测试正式创下了 “手机壳保护下最高海拔跌落（自然地貌）” 的吉尼斯世界纪录。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281944111657.png
AirX手机壳采用单一可回收材料制成，设计灵感来自汽车安全气囊与运动鞋中的缓震结构。犀牛盾表示，他们在发射前已针对冰冻温度和大气压力进行了模拟测试。“我们做了最坏的打算，但也抱持最好的希望，”品牌体验经理Mujou Hsiao表示。

news.title: 孙宇晨4500万香蕉扯下来给朋友 还让保姆现粘现分
news.summary: 近日，知名人物孙宇晨因与女星景甜的法律纠纷成为舆论焦点。而随着事件的发酵，一则关于孙宇晨早年花4500万拍下“胶带粘香蕉”艺术…

content.v: 近日，知名人物孙宇晨因与女星景甜的法律纠纷成为舆论焦点。而随着事件的发酵，一则关于孙宇晨早年花4500万拍下“胶带粘香蕉”艺术品的旧事也被翻出，再次引发热议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281935487538.jpg
据悉，孙宇晨曾花费数百万美元（折合约4500万人民币）拍下意大利艺术家莫瑞吉奥·卡特兰的知名作品《喜剧演员》——一根用胶带粘在墙上的香蕉。
据一位自称与孙宇晨和景甜均有交集的网友在社交平台爆料，他曾在孙宇晨家中做客，当时孙宇晨带着众人参观其豪宅，走到这幅香蕉画前时，他当场扯下香蕉分给在场的朋友，随后让保姆重新粘上一根，再扯下分给下一个人，如此反复操作，分发了多根香蕉。
该网友回忆称，孙宇晨在分香蕉时表示“请你们每人吃了4500万”，暗示每根香蕉都承载着那件艺术品的价值。
对此，该网友坦言内心“无数草泥马在奔腾”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281936299581.jpg
据悉，孙宇晨在拍下该作品后确实曾将香蕉当场吃掉，并称其为“一次艺术体验”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281936307200.jpg

others.title: 枪膛有数，生死无常！轮盘赌构筑肉鸽游戏《雪夜枪声》现已发售

content.v: 由OFFLAB开发的俄罗斯轮盘赌肉鸽游戏《雪夜枪声》现已在Steam正式发售，原价22元，首发期间购入享15%折扣优惠，前两周到手仅需18.7元！
在《雪夜枪声》中，玩家将操控一队身怀绝技的角色，在黑雾笼罩的雪原上与穷凶极恶的邪教徒进行残酷的轮盘赌。为了活下去，玩家需要在对敌开枪或朝自己扣动扳机之间抉择，甚至使用各种“卑鄙”的技能与手段让胜利的天平向自己倾斜。
观察，并思考……
在玩家与敌人进行轮盘赌时，双方首先需要交替装填子弹，来决定子弹的排序和开枪优先权，最后完成装弹的一方可以优先进行射击。向自己射击可以继续开枪，朝敌人开枪则会将主动权交给对方……如此推进，直到枪中的实弹都被射出。
合理地排序装弹，并通过空包弹推理出实弹的位置，避开致命枪击，是游戏中赢下对决的基础。
https://image.gcores.com/56d1b2799aa7e2eadec2a0b00995eb0e-1920-1080.png
卑鄙也是活下去的通行证
在游戏中，玩家也可以通过各类技能、道具削弱敌人，从而在轮盘赌中获得巨大优势，甚至不开枪也能赢下决斗。玩家每次向自己开枪都可以获得一颗“勇气宝石”，通过积累、消耗“勇气宝石”，可以发动各种技能：
有的技能可以让正在进行决斗的人下场，替换其他队伍成员继续决斗；有的技能可以直接对敌人造成精神攻击，使其崩溃无法继续战斗；有的技能表面上是投降叛逃，实际上是派出卧底打入敌人内部……
https://image.gcores.com/74283b370cc4c9a1c198a222354443f2-1920-1080.png
不同风格，战至极限
在《雪夜枪声》的正式版中，玩家可操纵的队伍类型由Demo中的1种提升至3种，不同的队伍拥有不同的技能池，也代表了不同的决斗方式。此外，还有3个全新的技能组扩展包，让玩家在基础的建队上获得更多选择。
正式版提供了 4 个难度选项，还有全新的BOSS和真结局路线。在不断臻至极致的挑战中，寻找雪原的尽头吧！
https://image.gcores.com/ac44fb144a1f78a4c94ef5f911473290-1920-1080.png
欢迎点击下方Steam商店页链接，支持《雪夜枪声》；也欢迎关注官方社媒账号，加入QQ交流群讨论游玩心得！
